muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وتلك حجتنا آتيناها إبراهيم على قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (وتلك): a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (حجتنا) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (آتيناها) is a second khabar or a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governing element (ʿāmil) in it being the sense of pointing; (آتيناها) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إبراهيم) is a second mafʿūl bihi; (على قومه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, or to (بحجتنا).
﴿نرفع درجات من نشاء إن ربك حكيم عليم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (آتيناها), i.e. "in the state of our being raisers"; (درجات) is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial); (من) is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (نشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; (حكيم عليم) are its two predicates; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿ووهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب كلا هدينا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, joining to His saying (وتلك حجتنا); (وهبنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إسحاق) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يعقوب) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (إسحاق); (كلًّا) is a mafʿūl bihi placed before (هدينا); (هدينا) is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined to (وهبنا).
﴿ونوحا هدينا من قبل﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes; (نوحًا) is a mafʿūl (object) placed before (هدينا); (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هدينا); (قبل) is an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the iḍāfa (genitive construct) in wording but not in meaning, i.e. "before Ibrāhīm".
﴿ومن ذريته داود وسليمان وأيوب ويوسف وموسى وهارون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من ذريته) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "and We guided Dāwūd and Sulaymān"; and the sentence of the fourteen prophets after Nūḥ is accusative (manṣūb) by the verb of guiding that put ﴿نوحًا﴾ in the accusative.
﴿وكذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "and with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "naḥnu" (we); and ﴿المحسنين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿وزكريا ويحيى وعيسى وإلياس كل من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نوحًا﴾; (كل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (من الصالحين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وإسماعيل واليسع ويونس ولوطا﴾: the wāw is for conjunction, and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نوحًا﴾.
﴿وكلا فضلنا على العالمين﴾: (كلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before (فضلنا); (على العالمين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضلنا).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿ومن آبائهم وذرياتهم وإخوانهم واجتبيناهم﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes, i.e. "and We guided each of their fathers"; (اجتبيناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهديناهم إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إلى صراط) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هديناهم); and (مستقيم) is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿ذلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء من عباده﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (ذلك) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (هدى الله) is the khabar (predicate); the clause (يهدي) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar; or ﴿هدى الله﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative and the clause (يهدي) is the khabar; (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي); (من) is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (من عباده) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the relative noun.
﴿ولو أشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) is conditional; (أشركوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause (حبط) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; (عنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حبط); (ما) is a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause (كانوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause (يعملون) is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿أولئك الذين آتيناهم الكتاب والحكم والنبوة﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (أولئك) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), the pointing being to the eighteen prophets mentioned; (الذين) is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; the clause (آتيناهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (الكتاب) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it.
﴿فإن يكفر بها هؤلاء فقد وكلنا بها قوما ليسوا بها بكافرين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (يكفر) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكفر); (هؤلاء) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (وكلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (بها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وكلنا); (قومًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (ليسوا) is an adjective (ṣifa); (بها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بكافرين); the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and (كافرين) is genitive in wording and accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of (ليسوا).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿أولئك الذين هدى الله﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. the prophets mentioned; (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); and the clause (هدى الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿فبهداهم اقتده﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "if you wish to follow the upright path and rise to the loftiest responsibilities, then follow their guidance"; (اقتد) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt); and the clause occurring after the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل لا أسألكم عليه أجرا﴾: the clause (قل) is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause (لا أسألكم) is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (أجرًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (أسألكم).
﴿إن هو إلا ذكرى للعالمين﴾: (إن) is negating; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ذكرى) is the khabar (predicate); (للعالمين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿إن هو إلا ذكرى﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الحمد لله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض وجعل الظلمات والنور﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject); لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); الذي is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; السماوات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿وجعل الظلمات والنور﴾ is conjoined to the first clause.
﴿ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay, and the conjunction is onto His words ﴿الحمد لله﴾ and what follows it, in the sense that: Allah is worthy of praise for what He created, because He created what He created as a blessing for mankind; then those who disbelieve in Him equate [others with Him] and so are ungrateful for His blessing. الذين is a mubtadaʾ; كفروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position; بربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كفروا, or attached to يعدلون, i.e. then those who disbelieve make others from among the created beings equal to their Lord; and the object is omitted.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿هو الذي خلقكم من طين ثم قضى أجلا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), الذي is the khabar (predicate); the clause خلقكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; من طين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقكم; ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; قضى أجلًا is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined to the clause خلقكم.
﴿وأجل مسمى عنده ثم أنتم تمترون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; أجل is a mubtadaʾ — beginning with it is permissible although it is indefinite because it is described by His word ﴿مسمى﴾; عنده is an adverb of place attached to its omitted khabar; ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction expressing improbability (istibʿād), because of the distance between the two ranks; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause تمترون is its khabar; and the clause ﴿وأجل مسمى عنده﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وهو الله في السماوات وفي الأرض يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject), or ﴿هو﴾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿الله﴾ is the khabar (predicate); في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the name Allah, i.e. the One worshipped in them; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to the meaning of the name Allah; the clause يعلم is a second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; سركم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and جهركم is conjoined to سركم; the clause ويعلم is conjoined to the clause يعلم; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause تكسبون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وما تأتيهم من آية من آيات ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; تأتيهم is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; آية is genitive in form and nominative in position as the fāʿil (agent) of تأتيهم; من آيات ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; إلا is a particle of restriction; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun; ﴿عنها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate) ﴿معرضين﴾; the clause كانوا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; and the clause ﴿وما تأتيهم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فقد كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ implying an omitted condition); قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كذبوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا, i.e. since they turn away from it, they have denied what is greater than it, namely the truth; and the clause has no grammatical position. لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa), so it is attached [Translator's note: the source does not say to what], and the clause جاءهم is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿فسوف يأتيهم أنباء ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; سوف is a particle of the future; يأتيهم is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أنباء is a postponed fāʿil; ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; the wāw is the noun of كان, and the clause يستهزئون is its khabar (predicate); به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستهزئون.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ألم يروا كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the hamza is for an interrogative of affirmation (taqrīr) and rebuke (tawbīkh) at the same time; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the seeing is visual or cognitive; كم is declarative (khabariyya), or interrogative, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted object of أهلكنا; the clause أهلكنا stands in place of the object, or the two objects, of the seeing; من قبلهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and من قرن is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the tamyīz (specification) of ﴿كم﴾.
﴿مكناهم في الأرض﴾: the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قرن﴾; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مكناهم; مكناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مكناهم﴾. [Translator's note: the source states the attachment of في الأرض twice.]
﴿ما لم نمكن لكم﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is a described indefinite (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of accusative, standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "an establishing which We did not establish", and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as an adjective. Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, an adjective of something omitted; on this view too it is in the position of accusative standing in for the absolute object, the implied form being "the establishing which We did not establish for you", and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position, and the pronoun referring back to ﴿ما﴾ is omitted, i.e. "which We did not establish (it) for you". ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; نمكن is an imperfect verb, jussive by لم; and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نمكن﴾.
﴿وأرسلنا السماء عليهم مدرارا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أرسلنا السماء is a verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا; and مدرارًا is a ḥāl.
﴿وجعلنا الأنهار تجري من تحتهم فأهلكناهم بذنوبهم﴾: also conjoined to what precedes; the clause تجري من تحتهم is in the position of accusative as the second object of جعلنا. فأهلكناهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, أهلكناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; بذنوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أهلكناهم.
﴿وأنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين﴾: also conjoined; أنشأنا is a verb and its fāʿil; من بعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنشأنا; قرنًا is the mafʿūl bihi, and آخرين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ولو نزلنا عليك كتابا في قرطاس فلمسوه بأيديهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; نزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نزلنا; كتابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في قرطاس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتابًا﴾. ﴿فلمسوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمسوه is a verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi, conjoined to نزلنا; بأيديهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to لمسوه.
﴿لقال الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; قال الذين is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause كفروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); إن is negative; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; سحر is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هذا﴾, and مبين an adjective; and the negative clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وقالوا لولا أنزل عليه ملك﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) that needs no apodosis; أنزل is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; ملك is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause of urging is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولو أنزلنا ملكا لقضي الأمر ثم لا ينظرون﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; أنزلنا ملكًا is a verb, its fāʿil and object; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; the clause قضي الأمر has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; لا is negative; ينظرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), built for that whose agent is not named, conjoined to قضي الأمر; and the wāw is the deputy agent.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ولو جعلناه ملكا لجعلناه رجلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; جعلناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ملكًا is a second object; the pronoun refers to the warner whom they proposed; the lām links the apodosis of لو; the clause جعلناه رجلًا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿ولو جعلناه ملكا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وللبسنا عليهم ما يلبسون﴾: وللبسنا is conjoined to ﴿لجعلناه﴾. عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) لبسنا. ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿يلبسون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun with no grammatical position, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. "what they confuse (it)". Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), i.e. "We would have confused them with a confusion like that with which they confuse others", so that together with what follows it, it is an interpreted maṣdar, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of ﴿لبسنا﴾, and the clause ﴿يلبسون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); استهزئ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); برسل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استهزئ, and the two have stood in for the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من قبلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; حاق is a past verb conjoined to استهزئ; بالذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حاق; the clause سخروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سخروا; ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of حاق, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun or maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming); كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause يستهزئون is its khabar (predicate); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يستهزئون﴾, and the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers to the Messenger, or to the word ﴿ما﴾, whether maṣdariyya or relative.

muyesser-irab:155-155.t: ﴿وهذا كتاب أنزلناه مبارك فاتبعوه واتقوا لعلكم ترحمون﴾: the و is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and كتاب is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أنزلناه﴾ is a first naʿt (adjective), and مبارك is a second naʿt; فاتبعوه: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e.: "if you wish to benefit from its blessing"; and اتبعوه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; اتقوا is conjoined to فاتبعوه, and the clause of hope (لعلكم ترحمون) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:156-156.t:
﴿أن تقولوا إنما أنزل الكتاب على طائفتين من قبلنا﴾: أن and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "out of dislike that you should say"; إنما is the restraining ما (kāffa) and the restrained particle (makfūfa); أنزل is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and الكتاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); على طائفتين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل — what is meant by the two (groups) is the Jews and the Christians — and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); من قبلنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of طائفتين.
﴿وإن كنا عن دراستهم لغافلين﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إن is lightened from the heavy (inna), and is inoperative (muhmala); كنا is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿عن دراستهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافلين; the لام is the distinguishing lām between the lightened إن and the negating إن; and غافلين is the khabar of كنا.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t:
﴿أو تقولوا لو أنا أنزل علينا الكتاب لكنا أهدى منهم﴾: conjoined to أن تقولوا; لو is conditional, أن is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause أنزل علينا الكتاب is its khabar; الكتاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; the لام occurs in the apodosis of لو; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and أهدى is its khabar; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أهدى.
﴿فقد جاءكم بينة من ربكم وهدى ورحمة﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa, because it is the answer to an omitted (statement) by which (what follows) is given as a reason, i.e.: "Do not make excuses, for the grounds for excuse have passed you by"; ﴿فقد جاءكم﴾: قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), and جاءكم is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بينة is the fāʿil (agent); or the omitted (element) is a condition, i.e.: "if you are truthful in the false promises and reckless dreams with which you beguile yourselves"; من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of بينة, or to جاءكم; هدى and رحمة are both conjoined to بينة.
﴿فمن أظلم ممن كذب بآيات الله وصدف عنها﴾: the ف is a conjunction for ordering what follows it upon what precedes it; من is interrogative, containing the sense of negation, i.e.: "no one", and it is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; أظلم is the khabar; ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أظلم; the clause كذب is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذب; and صدف عنها is conjoined to كذب.
﴿سنجزي الذين يصدفون عن آياتنا سوء العذاب﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نجزي is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and الذين is its object; the clause يصدفون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; سوء العذاب is accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi of نجزي, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); and the annexation of السوء to العذاب is the annexation of the attribute to what it describes, i.e.: "the evil punishment".
﴿بما كانوا يصدفون﴾: the ب is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar in the genitive by the ب; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نجزي﴾; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator, the و is its noun, and the clause يصدفون is its khabar, i.e.: "because of their turning away and their aversion".

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة أو يأتي ربك أو يأتي بعض آيات ربك﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; هل is an interrogative particle containing the sense of negation; ينظرون is an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تأتيهم الملائكة﴾ is an "emptied" excepted (mustathnā mufarragh), so it is an accusative mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and ﴿يأتي ربك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم الملائكة﴾; and ﴿أو يأتي بعض آيات ربك﴾ is conjoined as well.
﴿يوم يأتي بعض آيات ربك لا ينفع نفسا إيمانها لم تكن آمنت من قبل أو كسبت في إيمانها خيرا﴾: the adverb (يوم) is attached to His saying ﴿لا ينفع﴾; the clause يأتي بعض آيات ربك is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); لا is negating, and ينفع نفسًا إيمانها is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; the clause ﴿لم تكن آمنت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نفسًا﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause آمنت is the khabar of تكن; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and كسبت is conjoined to آمنت; في إيمانها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كسبت; and خيرًا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قل انتظروا إنا منتظرون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿انتظروا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿إنا منتظرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and منتظرون is its khabar; and the clause is likewise resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:159-159.t:
﴿إن الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا لست منهم في شيء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, and الذين is its noun; the clause فرقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; دينهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وكانوا﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause, and شيعًا is the khabar of كانوا; the clause لست is the khabar of إن; ﴿لست﴾ is an abrogating past verb, and the ت is its noun; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, since the (intended) meaning is completed by it; في شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the (notion of) settledness (istiqrār) to which منهم is attached, i.e.: "you are not settled among them in anything"; or ﴿في شيء﴾ is the khabar, and منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) placed before it.
﴿إنما أمرهم إلى الله ثم ينبئهم بما كانوا يفعلون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إنما is the restraining ما and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أمرهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); ثم is a conjunction; ينبئهم is an imperfect verb, and the هاء is its object; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the second object; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause يفعلون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:160-160.t:
﴿من جاء بالحسنة فله عشر أمثالها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; من is a jussive conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); جاء is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); بالحسنة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاء; the ف links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عشر is the postponed mubtadaʾ, and أمثالها is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ومن جاء بالسيئة فلا يجزى إلا مثلها﴾: conjoined to what preceded; من is a jussive conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ; جاء is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; بالحسنة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاء [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in this ayah is بالسيئة — apparently carried over from the previous line]; the ف links the apodosis; لا is negating; يجزى is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), in the nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; the clause فلا يجزى is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; إلا is a particle of restriction; and مثلها is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the و is a conjunction; هم is the mubtadaʾ; لا is negating; يظلمون is an imperfect verb in the passive, and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿قل إنني هداني ربي إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it serves to repeat what must be done and said; إن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun, and the clause ﴿هداني﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إلى صراط is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هداني, as its second object.
﴿دينا قيما ملة إبراهيم حنيفا﴾: دينًا is accusative as a badal (substitute) from the position of ﴿إلى صراط﴾, because its meaning is "He guided me to a path (صراطًا)"; or it is accusative as a maṣdar (absolute object), i.e.: "He guided me with the guidance of an upright religion"; قيمًا is a naʿt (adjective), i.e.: "upright"; ملة إبراهيم is a badal from دينًا; and حنيفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from إبراهيم.
﴿وما كان من المشركين﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective past verb, an abrogator, and its noun is latent (mustatir); من المشركين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause is conjoined to the ḥāl, so it is a ḥāl after a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:162-162.t: ﴿قل إن صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what follows it is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle; صلاتي is the noun of إن; ﴿نسكي ومحياي ومماتي﴾ are conjoined to صلاتي; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; رب is a naʿt (adjective), and العالمين is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿لا شريك له وبذلك أمرت﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, and شريك is its noun; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from رب العالمين, or a naʿt (adjective) of it; the و is a conjunction; بذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمرت; and أمرت is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the تاء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وأنا أول المسلمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أول المسلمين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿قل أغير الله أبغي ربا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the hamza is for interrogation containing the sense of negation, i.e.: "I do not seek a lord other than Him"; غير الله is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ربًّا is a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿أغير الله﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وهو رب كل شيء﴾: the و is circumstantial; هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and رب كل شيء is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ولا تكسب كل نفس إلا عليها﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is negating; تكسب كل نفس is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a muḍāf ilayhi; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "except in the state of its sin weighing upon it, with what harms it and does not benefit it".
﴿ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is negating; تزر وازرة is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; وزر is a mafʿūl bihi, and أخرى is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم فيه تختلفون﴾: ثم is a conjunction; إلى ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مرجعكم is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the ف is a conjunction; ينبئكم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the ب is a preposition of causality; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the ب, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the second object; the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator, and the تاء is its noun; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تختلفون﴾; and the clause تختلفون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿وهو الذي جعلكم خلائف الأرض﴾: the و is a conjunction; هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause جعلكم is the ṣila (relative clause); and خلائف الأرض is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلكم.
﴿ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات﴾: the و is a conjunction; رفع is a past verb, and بعضكم is a mafʿūl bihi; فوق بعض is an adverb of place attached to رفع; and درجات is an adverb (ẓarf).
﴿ليبلوكم في ما آتاكم إن ربك سريع العقاب﴾: the لام is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); يبلوكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the lām of reason, and the lām of reason and the interpreted maṣdar are attached to ﴿رفع﴾; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبلوكم﴾; the clause آتاكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; إن is an abrogating particle, ربك is its noun, and سريع العقاب is its khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it gives the reason.
﴿وإنه لغفور رحيم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; وإنه: إن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun; the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفور is the khabar of إن; and رحيم is a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وما قدروا الله حق قدره﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (ما) is negating; ﴿قدروا الله﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; (حق) stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is its adjective (ṣifa), the implied form being "they did not estimate Allah with His true estimation" (ما قدروا الله قدرَه الحقَّ); (قدره) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf; and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ قالوا ما أنزل الله على بشر من شيء﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قدروا﴾; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the clause (ما أنزل الله) is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (من) is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and (شيء) is genitive in wording, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) accusative in position.
﴿قل من أنزل الكتاب الذي جاء به موسى نورا وهدى للناس﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (من) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (أنزل الكتاب) is the khabar (predicate); (الذي) is a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of (الكتاب); the clause (جاء به موسى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; (نورًا) is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (هدى) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نورًا﴾; and (للناس) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (هدى).
﴿تجعلونه قراطيس تبدونها وتخفون كثيرا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الكتاب), or of the pronoun in (به); (تجعلونه) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قراطيس) is a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause (تبدونها) is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿قراطيس﴾; the clause (وتخفون كثيرًا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause (تبدونها); and (كثيرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تخفون﴾.
﴿وعلمتم ما لم تعلموا أنتم ولا آباؤكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the clause (علمتم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause (تجعلونه), within the scope of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (علمتم) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (لم تعلموا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (أنتم) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil (agent), which is the wāw in ﴿لم تعلموا﴾; ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; and (آباؤكم) is conjoined to His saying ﴿أنتم﴾.
﴿قل الله ثم ذرهم في خوضهم يلعبون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "Allah sent it down" (الله أنزله) or "He is Allah" (هو الله); (ثم) is a conjunction; (ذرهم) is an imperative verb; (في خوضهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ذرهم), or to (يلعبون), or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause (يلعبون) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the object of (ذرهم).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿وهذا كتاب أنزلناه مبارك مصدق الذي بين يديه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (هذا) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كتاب) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أنزلناه) is in the position of the nominative as a first adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿كتاب﴾; (مبارك) is a second adjective; (مصدق) is a third adjective; (الذي) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and (يديه) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولتنذر أم القرى ومن حولها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is causal (for taʿlīl); (تنذر) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām; "an" and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلناه); (أم القرى) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مَن) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (أم القرى); (حولها) is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿والذين يؤمنون بالآخرة يؤمنون به﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (الذين) is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يؤمنون بالآخرة) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause (يؤمنون به) is the khabar (predicate). Or the wāw is conjunctive and (الذين) is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (أم القرى), i.e. "that you may warn the people of the Mother of Towns and that you may warn those who believed", and the second clause ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun.
﴿وهم على صلاتهم يحافظون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يحافظون) is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (من) is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) is its khabar (predicate); (ممن) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم); the clause (افترى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى); and ﴿كذبا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (افترى), i.e. "he fabricated a lie and contrived it"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he fabricated for the sake of lying"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he fabricated while being a liar", and it is a corroborative ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida).
﴿أو قال أوحي إلي ولم يوح إليه شيء﴾: (أو) is a conjunction; (قال) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (افترى); (أوحي) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); (إليَّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the nominative, the two being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (أوحي); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause (لم يوح) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in ﴿قال﴾, or of the yāʾ in ﴿إليَّ﴾; and (شيء) is the nāʾib fāʿil of ﴿يوح﴾.
﴿ومن قال سأنزل مثل ما أنزل الله﴾: (أو) is a conjunction [Translator's note: the word in the ayah is the wāw (ومن), not (أو); the source appears to carry this over from the previous line]; (من) is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying) [Translator's note: so in the source; (من) here is a relative noun conjoined to what precedes, while the maqūl al-qawl is the clause (سأنزل …)]; ﴿مثل﴾ is accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); and the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿مثل﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "I will send down a sending-down like what Allah sent down" (سأنزل إنزالًا مثل ما أنزل الله); on this view ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ has no grammatical position because it occurs after a particle-type relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī).
﴿ولو ترى إذ الظالمون في غمرات الموت﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لو) is conditional; (ترى) is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) of (لو); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of (لو) is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a tremendous thing"; the seeing is visual and its object is omitted, i.e. "and if you could see the wrongdoers when they are in the floods of death"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ترى); (الظالمون) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في غمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿الظالمون﴾; (الموت) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the nominal clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿والملائكة باسطو أيديهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (الملائكة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (باسطو) is the khabar (predicate); (أيديهم) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in meaning; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun latent in the khabar, which is ﴿في غمرات الموت﴾.
﴿أخرجوا أنفسكم اليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تقولون على الله غير الحق﴾: the clause (أخرجوا أنفسكم) is made accusative by an implied verb of saying, i.e. "saying to them in rebuke and reproach"; this saying is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun latent in the active participle, which is ﴿باسطو﴾; (أنفسكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (اليوم) is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجوا) or to (تجزون); the clause ﴿تجزون...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; (تجزون) is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (عذاب الهون) is a second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and (ما) is maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تجزون), i.e. "because of it"; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause (تقولون) is the khabar (predicate) of (كنتم); and (غير الحق) is an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "you say the saying that is not the truth".
﴿وكنتم عن آياته تستكبرون﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first (كنتم), falling within the scope of the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, which is ﴿ما﴾; (عن آياته) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تستكبرون); and the clause (تستكبرون) is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿ولقد جئتمونا فرادى كما خلقناكم أول مرة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿جئتمونا﴾ is a past verb: the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is the sign of the plural, the wāw is for prolonging the ḍamma of the mīm, and ﴿نا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فرادى﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (جئتمونا); ﴿كما خلقناكم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of (جئتمونا), or in the position of an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "i.e. a coming like Our creating you" [Translator's note: "أي" is repeated in the source]; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival); ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿أول مرة﴾ is accusative as an adverb of time, its governing element being (خلقناكم).
﴿وتركتم ما خولناكم وراء ظهوركم﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (جئتمونا), with "qad" implied; (تركتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (ترك) takes a single object because it means "leaving behind", not "making into"; or it means "making into", and so takes two objects, the first being the relative ﴿ما﴾ and the second the adverb, which is then attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "and by leaving you made what We bestowed on you to be behind your backs"; on the first view the adverb is attached to (تركتم).
﴿وما نرى معكم شفعاءكم الذين زعمتم أنهم فيكم شركاء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negating; (نرى) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (معكم) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نرى); (شفعاءكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is an adjective (naʿt); the clause (زعمتم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿أن﴾ and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of (زعم); (أن) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; (فيكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (شركاء) is the khabar (predicate) of (أن).
﴿لقد تقطع بينكم﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (تقطع) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is an implied pronoun referring to the connection indicated by the word ﴿شركاء﴾, i.e. "the connection between you has been cut off".
﴿وضل عنكم ما كنتم تزعمون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ضل) is a past verb; (عنكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ضل); (ما) is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); the clause (كنتم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause (تزعمون) is the khabar (predicate) of (كنتم); and the two objects of (تزعمون) are omitted, the implied form being "you claimed them to be intercessors" (تزعمونهم شفعاء).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿إن الله فالق الحب والنوى يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; the Divine Name is its noun; (فالق) is its khabar (predicate); (الحب) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the annexation being non-genuine (ghayr maḥḍa), so that (الحب) is genitive in wording and accusative in position; or the annexation is genuine (maḥḍa); (النوى) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (الحب); the clause (يخرج الحي) is resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾; (من الميت) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخرج); (مخرج) is conjoined to (فالق), i.e. "Allah is the Splitter and the Bringer-out", or conjoined to (يخرج) because the parts of the speech accord with one another, in which case the verb must be interpreted as a noun for the conjoining of the noun to it to be sound, or the reverse; and (من الحي) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مخرج).
﴿ذلكم الله فأنى تؤفكون﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿الله﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (أنى) is an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (تؤفكون) is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿قل سيروا في الأرض ثم انظروا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause سيروا is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سيروا; ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; and انظروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of انظروا; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, and عاقبة is its noun; it [the interrogative] has suspended (ʿallaqat) the looking from governing in form; and المكذبين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿قل لمن ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is an interrogative noun expressing rebuke and denial; ما is a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. والأرض: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿قل لله كتب على نفسه الرحمة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is Allah's"; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; the clause ﴿كتب على نفسه الرحمة﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; على نفسه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كتب; and الرحمة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ليجمعنكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه﴾: the lām is the answer to the omitted oath understood from His words ﴿كتب على نفسه﴾, as though He swore to that; the clause يجمعنكم has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath; إلى يوم القيامة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "resurrected" or "gathered" to the Day of Resurrection; لا is the lā of generic negation, ريب is its noun, فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl clause.
﴿الذين خسروا أنفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون﴾: ﴿الذين﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿خسروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿خسروا أنفسهم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فهم لا يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the fāʾ is brought into the khabar clause because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿الذين خسروا أنفسهم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وله ما سكن في الليل والنهار﴾: the wāw is resumptive; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause سكن في الليل والنهار is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. Or the wāw is a conjunction, coordinating with His words ﴿لله﴾, i.e. "Say: it is Allah's, and say: His is whatever dwells…". The clause ﴿وله ما سكن...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو السميع العليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, السميع a first khabar, and العليم a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قل أغير الله أتخذ وليا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī); غير الله is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أتخذ, and وليًّا the second object; and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فاطر السماوات والأرض وهو يطعم ولا يطعم﴾: فاطر السماوات والأرض is a naʿt (adjective) or a badal (substitute) of لله; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يطعم, in the active voice, is the khabar (predicate); and the clause لا يطعم, built for that whose agent is not named (passive), is conjoined to it.
﴿قل إني أمرت أن أكون أول من أسلم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أمرت is its khabar; إنّ with its noun and khabar is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; أمرت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أن﴾ and what is in its scope form an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمرت; أول is the khabar of أكون; من is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and the clause أسلم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تكونن من المشركين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكونن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; and the clause is the object of an omitted speech, conjoined to what precedes, i.e. "and it was said to me: do not be…"; ﴿من المشركين﴾ is the khabar of ﴿تكونن﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿قل إني أخاف﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). إنّ: an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun. The clause ﴿أخاف﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿إني أخاف...﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إن عصيت ربي﴾: إن is conditional. عصيت: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The tāʾ: fāʿil. ربي: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The conditional sentence is parenthetical with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: عذاب: mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أخاف﴾. يوم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). عظيم: naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿من يصرف عنه يومئذ فقد رحمه﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب يوم عظيم; من is conditional, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); يصرف is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he/it" (هو); عنه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصرف. ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يصرف﴾, and إذٍ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause contained in the preceding speech, the implied form being "on the day when the requital takes place". The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); رحمه is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; and the clause of the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وذلك الفوز المبين﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, الفوز is the khabar, and المبين is an adjective; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause in the position of accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿وإن يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له إلا هو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يمسسك is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the kāf is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿الله﴾ is its fāʿil (agent), postponed in wording; بضرّ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يمسسك. ﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation, and كاشف is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كاشف; إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿هو﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the position of لا and its noun; the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لا﴾ is omitted, i.e. "existent"; and the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وإن يمسسك بخير فهو على كل شيء قدير﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the clause ﴿وهو على كل شيء قدير﴾ gives the reason for the omitted apodosis, i.e. "then none can repel it other than Him"; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), قدير the khabar, and على كل شيء a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير. [Translator's note: the source quotes the clause as ﴿وهو…﴾, whereas the ayah reads ﴿فهو…﴾.]

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وهو القاهر فوق عباده﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), القاهر the khabar (predicate); فوق عباده is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) القاهر, or attached to an omitted second khabar, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being exalted above"; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl clause in the position of accusative (manṣūb).
﴿وهو الحكيم الخبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, القاهر the first khabar [Translator's note: so in the source; in this phrase the first khabar is الحكيم — القاهر appears to be carried over from the preceding phrase], and الخبير the second khabar; and the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿قل أي شيء أكبر شهادة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); أي شيء is the mubtadaʾ (subject), أكبر the khabar (predicate), and شهادة a tamyīz (specification) converted from the mubtadaʾ; and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قل الله شهيد بيني وبينكم﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and شهيد its khabar; the two adverbs are attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهيد; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿وأوحي إلي هذا القرآن لأنذركم به ومن بلغ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; أوحي is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); إليَّ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحي; ﴿هذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of أوحي; القرآن is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; the clause is conjoined, or resumptive serving as a reason, with no grammatical position; the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); أنذركم is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām, and أن with the verb form an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أوحي; the kāf is the object. ﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a relative noun coordinated with the kāf in أنذركم, i.e. "that I may warn you and warn everyone whom the Qurʾan reaches". The clause ﴿وأوحي إلي...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أئنكم لتشهدون أن مع الله آلهة أخرى﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial and affirmation; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause تشهدون is its khabar; أنّ with its noun and khabar stands in place of the object of تشهدون; the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted speech, i.e. "and He says: do you indeed bear witness…"; أنّ is an abrogating particle; مع is an adverb of place attached to the omitted fronted khabar of أنّ; آلهة is its postponed noun, and أخرى an adjective of آلهة. [Translator's note: the source first says إنّ, then says that أنّ with its noun and khabar stands in place of the object; the latter refers to the أنّ of ﴿أن مع الله﴾.]
﴿قل لا أشهد﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لا is negative, أشهد is an imperfect verb, and the clause is accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿قل إنما هو إله واحد﴾: قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you"; the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; إنما is [إنّ] restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, إله the khabar, and واحد an adjective.
﴿وإنني بريء مما تشركون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إنّ is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and بريء its khabar; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), i.e. "of your associating [others] with Allah", or relative, i.e. "of the idols which you associate with Allah".

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿الذين آتيناهم الكتاب يعرفونه كما يعرفون أبناءهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; الذين is a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آتيناهم is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يعرفونه is the khabar (predicate) of الذين. ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "they know it with a knowing like their knowing of their sons"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming); ﴿يعرفون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يعرفون﴾ is the ṣila of maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿يعرفون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أبناءهم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الذين خسروا أنفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون﴾: ﴿الذين﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿خسروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿خسروا أنفسهم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فهم لا يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the fāʾ is brought into the khabar clause because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿الذين خسروا أنفسهم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation and rebuke, i.e. "no one is more unjust"; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) [Translator's note: so in the source; the mubtadaʾ here is the interrogative من], أظلم is the khabar (predicate); ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم; the clause افترى is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun with no grammatical position; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to افترى; ﴿كذبًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb افترى, i.e. he fabricated and contrived a lie; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. he fabricated for the sake of lying; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. he fabricated while lying, and it is a corroborative ḥāl. The clause ﴿ومن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿أو كذب بآياته﴾: conjoined to the clause افترى, falling within the scope of the ṣila, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه لا يفلح الظالمون﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause لا يفلح الظالمون is the khabar; the sentence gives the reason for what preceded.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ويوم نحشرهم جميعا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يوم is an adverb whose governor (that puts it in the accusative) is omitted and left vague, i.e. "and on the day We gather them, such-and-such will happen", or it is the object of an implied ﴿اذكر﴾ ("remember"); the clause نحشرهم is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿ويوم نحشرهم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم نقول للذين أشركوا أين شركاؤكم الذين كنتم تزعمون﴾: ثم is a conjunction of delay; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نقول; the clause أشركوا is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; أين is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb of place, the adverb being attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); شركاؤكم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء; the clause كنتم is the ṣila of الذين with no grammatical position; the tāʾ is the noun of كنتم and the clause تزعمون its khabar; and the two objects of تزعمون are omitted because they are known, i.e. "you claimed them to be partners".

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ثم لم تكن فتنتهم إلا أن قالوا﴾: ثم is a conjunction of delay; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تكن is an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; فتنتهم is the noun of تكن; إلا is a particle of restriction; and ﴿أن﴾ with what is in its scope forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), the khabar (predicate) of تكن.
﴿والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; the name of Majesty is genitive by the wāw, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being ﴿نقسم﴾ ("we swear"); ربنا is a badal (substitute) or naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الله﴾; the oath clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of their speech; ما is negative; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun and مشركين its khabar; and the clause ﴿ما كنا مشركين﴾ is the answer to an oath, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿انظر كيف كذبوا على أنفسهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; انظر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); كذبوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of accusative by انظر, because it has suspended it from governing; على أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا.
﴿وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is coordinated with the clause كذبوا, so it falls within the scope of the looking; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ضل is a past verb; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضل; ﴿ما﴾ is a nominal relative noun, the fāʿil of ضل, and the clause كانوا يفترون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb after it is the fāʿil of ضل; and the clause يفترون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿فالق الإصباح﴾: (فالق الإصباح) is an adjective (naʿt) of (الله), and (الإصباح) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وجعل الليل سكنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (جعل) is a past verb; (الليل) is its first object; and (سكنًا) is its second object, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿والشمس والقمر حسبانا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (الشمس) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (الليل); (حسبانًا) is conjoined to ﴿سكنًا﴾; or (حسبانًا) is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the preposition and its genitive noun being in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the two run by reckoning" (يجريان بحسبان).
﴿ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿تقدير﴾ is its khabar (predicate); (العزيز) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (العليم) is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿وهو الذي جعل لكم النجوم لتهتدوا بها في ظلمات البر والبحر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) is its khabar (predicate); (جعل) means "created", and so takes a single object; (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعل); (النجوم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لتهتدوا﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl) and makes genitive; (تهتدوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām of causation; "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to (جعل), by way of a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) with repetition of the governing element, the implied form being "He made the stars for you for your being guided" (جعل لكم النجوم لاهتدائكم); and (في ظلمات البر والبحر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you travel by night in the darknesses of the night on land and sea".
﴿قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يعلمون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (فصلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الآيات) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فصلنا); and the clause (يعلمون) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿وهو الذي أنشأكم من نفس واحدة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, joining to what precedes; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the relative noun is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أنشأكم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (من نفس) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنشأكم); and (واحدة) is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فمستقر ومستودع﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer to the relative noun because of the scent of condition in it; and (مستقر) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being "so for you there is a dwelling place" (فلكم مستقر).
﴿قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يفقهون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (فصلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الآيات) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فصلنا); and the clause (يفقهون) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿وهو الذي أنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به نبات كل شيء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the statement is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أنزل من السماء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun in the ayah is (الذي)]; (ماء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is conjunctive; (أخرجنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجنا); and (نبات كل شيء) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأخرجنا منه خضرا نخرج منه حبا متراكبا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أخرجنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجنا); (خضرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (نخرج) is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خضرًا﴾; (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نخرج); (حبًّا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (متراكبًا) is an adjective.
﴿ومن النخل من طلعها قنوان دانية﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or parenthetical; (من النخل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (من طلعها) is a badal (substitute) of the preposition and genitive noun before it, with repetition of the preposition, the badal here being a badal of part for whole; (قنوان) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (دانية) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (قنوان); and the clause ﴿ومن النخل...﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿فأخرجنا منه خضرًا﴾, or parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿وجنات من أعناب والزيتون والرمان مشتبها وغير متشابه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (جنات) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (نبات), so it is accusative, i.e. "so We brought out with the water vegetation and gardens"; (من أعناب) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa); likewise (الزيتون) and (الرمان); or (الزيتون) and (الرمان) are accusative by specification (ikhtiṣāṣ); (مشتبهًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (غير متشابه) is conjoined to it.
﴿انظروا إلى ثمره إذا أثمر وينعه﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, placed first; (انظروا) is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى ثمره) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (انظروا); (إذا) is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis, which is (انظروا); the clause (أثمر) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); and (ينعه) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ثمره).
﴿إن في ذلكم لآيات لقوم يؤمنون﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (في ذلكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن), placed first; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آيات) is the noun of (إن); (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of (آيات); and the clause (يؤمنون) is an adjective of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿وجعلوا لله شركاء الجن﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (جعلوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شركاء), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of it; (شركاء) is the second object of (جعلوا); and (الجن) is the first object.
﴿وخلقهم وخرقوا له بنين وبنات بغير علم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and "qad" must be implied after it; the clause (وخلقهم) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (وخرقوا): the wāw is a conjunction, and (خرقوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خرقوا); (بنين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بنات) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (بنين); (بغير علم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of (خرقوا), i.e. "they contrived the lie accompanied by ignorance, which is the absence of knowledge"; and the clause is conjoined to the clause (وخلقهم).
﴿سبحانه وتعالى عما يصفون﴾: (سبحانه) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (تعالى) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the implied verb governing (سبحانه); (عما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعالى﴾; the clause (يصفون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause of declaring Allah's transcendence (tanzīh) is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿بديع السماوات والأرض أنى يكون له ولد﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (بديع السماوات والأرض) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the Originator" (هو بديع); (أنى) is an interrogative noun meaning "how" or "from where", in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿يكون﴾ is a defective imperfect verb; (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of (يكون), placed first; ﴿ولد﴾ is its noun, placed after; and the clause ﴿أنى يكون له ولد﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم تكن له صاحبة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لم) is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; (تكن) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (تكن), placed first; and (صاحبة) is its noun, placed after.
﴿وخلق كل شيء وهو بكل شيء عليم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the position of the accusative; ﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (بكل شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عليم); and (عليم) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿ذلكم الله ربكم﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الله﴾ is a first khabar (predicate); and ﴿ربكم﴾ is a second khabar.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) of the position of (لا) and its noun, since their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is a third khabar.
﴿خالق كل شيء فاعبدوه﴾: (خالق كل شيء) is a fourth khabar (predicate); ﴿فاعبدوه﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); (اعبدوه) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وهو على كل شيء وكيل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (على كل شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وكيل); and (وكيل) is the khabar (predicate) of (هو).

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
