﴿لا تدركه الأبصار﴾: the clause is a fifth khabar (predicate); (تدركه الأبصار) is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and a fāʿil (agent).
﴿وهو يدرك الأبصار﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يدرك الأبصار) is its khabar (predicate); and (وهو): the wāw is a conjunction.
﴿وهو اللطيف الخبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللطيف) is a first khabar (predicate); and (الخبير) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿قد جاءكم بصائر من ربكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جاءكم بصائر) is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and a fāʿil (agent) placed after; and (من ربكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاءكم), or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of (بصائر).
﴿فمن أبصر فلنفسه ومن عمي فعليها﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, for detailing (tafṣīl); (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أبصر) is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then the seeing is for his own self" (فالإبصار لنفسه); ﴿ومن عمي فعليها﴾ is like it; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وما أنا عليكم بحفيظ﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which works as laysa works; ﴿أنا﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of (ما); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حفيظ); ﴿بحفيظ﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and (حفيظ) is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in wording by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وكذلك نصرف الآيات﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with a varying like that varying We vary the signs"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; and ﴿الآيات﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وليقولوا درست﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the verb after it, (يقولوا), is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied "an"; the clause ﴿ليقولوا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to something implied, i.e. "that they may take heed and that they may say"; and the clause ﴿درست﴾ is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
﴿ولنبينه لقوم يعلمون﴾: the wāw conjoins to the first lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نصرف); (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبينه); and the clause (يعلمون) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿اتبع ما أوحي إليك من ربك﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. (اتبع): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta" (you). ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أوحي): a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. The clause ﴿أوحي...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. (إليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحي﴾. (من ربك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحي﴾. (من ربك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحي﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being from your Lord". [Translator's note: the source repeats the analysis of (من ربك).]
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) of the position of (لا) and its noun, since their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأعرض عن المشركين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive. (أعرض): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent. (عن المشركين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرض﴾. The clause ﴿أعرض...﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause ﴿اتبع﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿ولو شاء الله ما أشركوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) is conditional; (شاء ربك) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has (شاء الله)]; the object of the willing is omitted, its implied form being "their not associating partners"; and the clause (ما أشركوا) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وما جعلناك عليهم حفيظا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negating; (جعلناك) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حفيظًا) is the second object of (جعلنا); and (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حفيظًا﴾.
﴿وما أنت عليهم بوكيل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which works as laysa works; ﴿أنت﴾ is the noun of (ما); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وكيل﴾; ﴿بوكيل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and (وكيل) is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in wording by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (لا) is prohibitive; (تسبوا) is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by it, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يدعون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (من دون الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فيسبوا الله عدوا بغير علم﴾: the fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (al-sababiyya); (يسبوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an"; "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no reviling of their gods from you, and then a reviling of Allah from them"; or the fāʾ is conjunctive and (يسبوا) is conjoined to (تسبوا); the Divine Name is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عدوًا) is accusative as a maṣdar because it is its synonym, or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of transgression", or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (بغير علم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted corroborative ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida).
﴿كذلك زينا لكل أمة عملهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with an adorning like that adorning We have adorned for every nation their deeds"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿زينا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زينا); ﴿أمة﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿عملهم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ثم إلى ربهم مرجعهم﴾: (ثم) is conjunctive, for sequence with delay, the conjoining being to something omitted, its implied form being "so they came to it" (فأتوه); (إلى ربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; and (مرجعهم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after.
﴿فينبئهم بما كانوا يعملون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, for sequence with immediacy; (ينبئهم) is an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the second object of (ينبئهم); the clause (كانوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause (يعملون) is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (أقسموا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقسموا); (جهد) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "they swore by Allah striving hard in their oaths", or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it has the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun), the meaning being "they swore an oath of utmost striving in swearing". (أيمانهم) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لئن جاءتهم آية ليؤمنن بها﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) is conditional; (جاءتهم) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its object; (آية) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ليؤمنن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath, since the oath precedes the condition; (يؤمنن) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis (nūn al-tawkīd al-thaqīla); and (بها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنن).
﴿قل إنما الآيات عند الله﴾: (قل) is an imperative verb, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إنما) is the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (الآيات) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); and (عند الله) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿وما يشعركم أنها إذا جاءت لا يؤمنون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (ما) is an interrogative noun of disapproval (istifhām inkārī) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يشعركم) is its khabar (predicate); the kāf is the first object of (يشعركم); "anna" and what lies within its scope are in the place of the second object; (إذا) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون); and the clause (لا يؤمنون) is the khabar of (أنها).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿ونقلب أفئدتهم وأبصارهم كما لم يؤمنوا به أول مرة﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position, or the wāw is conjunctive; (نقلب) is an imperfect verb; (أفئدتهم) is its object; (أبصارهم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (أفئدتهم); ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a turning like their not believing", a punishment equal to their disobedience; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival); ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; ﴿يؤمنوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); the clause ﴿لم يؤمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and its ṣila is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنوا﴾; and ﴿أول مرة﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾.
﴿ونذرهم في طغيانهم يعمهون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (نذرهم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (لا يؤمنون); (في طغيانهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يعمهون); and the clause (يعمهون) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "wandering in confusion".

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ومنهم من يستمع إليك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يستمع is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾ with no grammatical position; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستمع; and the sentence is conjoined, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا﴾: the wāw conjoins to the sentence before it, conjoining a verbal sentence to a nominal one; or the wāw is circumstantial with an implied ﴿قد﴾, i.e. "and We had made"; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); على قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعلنا as its second object, considering ﴿جعلنا﴾ to be [a verb] of transformation (taṣyīr); but if it means "We created", it is transitive to one [object] only, namely أكنة, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from it; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يفقهوه﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "out of dislike of their understanding"; and ﴿في آذانهم وقرًا﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وإن يروا كل آية لا يؤمنوا بها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; كل آية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negative; يؤمنوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنوا.
﴿حتى إذا جاءوك يجادلونك﴾: حتى here is a particle of limit and of the genitive, so that ﴿إذا جاءوك﴾ is in the position of genitive, i.e. "until the time of their coming", and the clause يجادلونك is a ḥāl; or ﴿حتى﴾ is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause يجادلونك is a ḥāl from the wāw in جاءوك.
﴿يقول الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; الذين is the fāʿil; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين with no grammatical position; إن is negative; هذا is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction; أساطير الأولين is the khabar; and the negated clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وهم ينهون عنه وينأون عنه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ينهون is the khabar (predicate); عنه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينهون; the pronoun ﴿هم﴾ refers to the disbelievers, and the pronoun in ﴿عنه﴾ refers to the Qurʾan or to the Prophet ﷺ; the clause ينأون عنه is conjoined to ينهون عنه. The sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن يهلكون إلا أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is negative; يهلكون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction; أنفسهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وما يشعرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negative; and the clause وما يشعرون is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على النار﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; ترى is an imperfect verb; the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen something astounding and tremendous"; ﴿ترى﴾ is visual, and its object is omitted, i.e. "if you were to see their states and witness them closely", or it is mental (qalbiyya), the meaning being: "if you turned your heart and thought to them to reflect on their states and fathom the reality of their affair at that time, you would increase in certainty"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترى; the clause ﴿وقفوا﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); على النار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وقفوا.
﴿فقالوا يا ليتنا نرد ولا نكذب بآيات ربنا ونكون من المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قالوا is conjoined to وقفوا; يا is a vocative particle, and the one addressed is omitted, or it is merely to draw attention; ليت is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿نرد﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya); لا is negative; نكذب is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the wāw of accompaniment, and ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to an imagined maṣdar, the implied form being: "would that there were for us a return, an absence of denial and being among the believers"; the clause of wishing is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the wāw is a conjunction, نكون is conjoined to نكذب, the noun of نكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن), and من المؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿بل بدا لهم ما كانوا يخفون من قبل﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; بدا is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) بدا; ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil (agent) of بدا; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; كان and its noun, and the clause يخفون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخفون.
﴿ولو ردوا لعادوا لما نهوا عنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو is conditional; ردوا is a past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو, and the clause لعادوا has no position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لما﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to عادوا; the clause نهوا عنه is the ṣila with no grammatical position, and the preposition and its genitive noun [عنه] are attached to نهوا.
﴿وإنهم لكاذبون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كاذبون is the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وقالوا إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا﴾: the wāw conjoins to the clause عادوا, so the clause falls within the scope of the apodosis; or [it conjoins] to His words ﴿وإنهم لكاذبون﴾; or it is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is negative; ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; حياتنا is the khabar (predicate), and الدنيا a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وما نحن بمبعوثين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative that acts like ليس; ﴿نحن﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the noun of ما. ﴿بمبعوثين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿مبعوثين﴾ is the khabar of Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على ربهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; ترى is an imperfect verb, and it is the condition of لو; its apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen something tremendous"; ﴿ترى﴾ is visual and its object is omitted, or mental (qalbiyya), the meaning being: "if you turned your heart and thought to reflect on their states and fathom the reality of their affair at that time, you would have increased in certainty"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for the past, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترى; the clause ﴿وقفوا﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); على ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وقفوا. The clause ﴿ولو ترى...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿قال أليس هذا بالحق﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), the owner of the ḥāl being ﴿ربهم﴾, as though it were said: "they were made to stand before Him, He saying to them: is this not the truth?"; the hamza is for the interrogative of rebuke and denial; ليس is an incomplete past verb; هذا is a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as its noun; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and الحق is genitive by the bāʾ in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar (predicate) of ليس.
﴿قالوا بلى وربنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; بلى is a particle of answer that cancels the negation. ﴿وربنا﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; ربنا is genitive by the wāw of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "we swear" (نقسم).
﴿قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if you knew this and then deviated from what it requires, then taste the punishment"; العذاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ذوقوا; the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is relative, i.e. "for that which you used to…", or maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), i.e. "for your having disbelieved"; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تكفرون is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); خسر is a past verb; الذين is a relative noun, its fāʿil (agent); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position; and بلقاء الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا.
﴿حتى إذا جاءتهم الساعة بغتة﴾: [حتى is] a particle of limit for the denial, or inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition; the clause جاءتهم الساعة is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿قالوا يا حسرتنا على ما فرطنا فيها﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; يا is a vocative particle; حسرتنا is the one addressed (munādā), in a construct (muḍāf); على ما فرطنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the regret (al-ḥasra); and the clause ﴿فرطنا فيها﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم يحملون أوزارهم على ظهورهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يحملون is the khabar (predicate); and على ظهورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحملون.
﴿ألا ساء ما يزرون﴾: ألا is a particle of drawing attention; ساء is a past verb for expressing blame; ﴿ما﴾ is a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma), accusative as a tamyīz (specification), and the clause يزرون is a naʿt (adjective); or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the fāʿil, and the clause يزرون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وما الحياة الدنيا إلا لعب ولهو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is negative; الحياة is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الدنيا a naʿt (adjective); إلا is a particle of restriction; لعب is the khabar (predicate) of الحياة, and لهو is conjoined to لعب.
﴿وللدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); الدار is the mubtadaʾ, الآخرة an adjective, and خير the khabar; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; the clause يتقون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and the sentence is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or the wāw is resumptive and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial, entering upon something implied; the fāʾ is a conjunction, and what it conjoins to is omitted, the implied form being "are you heedless, so that you do not reason?"; and the interrogative sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿قد نعلم إنه ليحزنك الذي يقولون﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿قد﴾ is originally for paucity, but here abundance is intended by it; نعلم is an imperfect verb transitive to two [objects]; إنّ and its noun, and the clause يحزنك is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; الذي is the fāʿil (agent) of يحزنك; the clause يقولون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي with no grammatical position; and ﴿إن﴾ with what is in its scope stands in place of the two objects of نعلم.
﴿فإنهم لا يكذبونك﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun; لا is negative, and the clause لا يكذبونك is its khabar.
﴿ولكن الظالمين بآيات الله يجحدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or a conjunction; لكنّ is an abrogating particle, and الظالمين is its noun; بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجحدون﴾; and the clause يجحدون is the khabar of لكنّ.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولقد كذبت رسل من قبلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كذبت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the tāʾ being the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; رسل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من قبلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسل.
﴿فصبروا على ما كذبوا وأوذوا حتى أتاهم نصرنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; صبروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), conjoined to كذبت; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to صبروا; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "upon their being denied"; أوذوا is conjoined to ﴿صبروا﴾; حتى is for limit, or inceptive; أتاهم نصرنا is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil.
﴿ولا مبدل لكلمات الله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لا is the lā of generic negation, and مبدل is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; لكلمات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿ولقد جاءك من نبأ المرسلين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation; جاءك is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [word] which is an adjective of the fāʿil and has taken its place, i.e. "some of their tidings have come to you", or "more of their tidings and stories"; or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) fāʿil in جاء, which refers to what is understood from the preceding sentence, i.e. "this news has come to you, being of the tidings of the messengers"; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وإن كان كبر عليك إعراضهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; كان is an incomplete past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the noun of كان is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause كبر عليك إعراضهم is the khabar (predicate); عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كبر; and إعراضهم is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فإن استطعت أن تبتغي نفقا في الأرض أو سلما في السماء﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of jussive as a protasis, and the apodosis is omitted, i.e. "then do so"; أن تبتغي is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of استطعت; the second condition with its apodosis is the apodosis of the first condition; في الأرض is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نفقًا﴾; and في السماء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿سلمًا﴾.
﴿فتأتيهم بآية﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and تأتيهم is an imperfect verb conjoined to تبتغي.
﴿ولو شاء الله لجمعهم على الهدى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; شاء الله is a verb and its fāʿil; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; the clause جمعهم على الهدى has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا تكونن من الجاهلين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if you know this, then do not be…"; لا is prohibitive; تكونن is an incomplete imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive by ﴿لا﴾; and من الجاهلين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of تكونن.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إنما يستجيب الذين يسمعون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إنما is [إنّ] restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يستجيب is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); الذين is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause يسمعون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position.
﴿والموتى يبعثهم الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الموتى is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يبعثهم الله is its khabar (predicate); or the wāw is a conjunction and الموتى is accusative (manṣūb) by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb) through a concealed verb indicated by the overt noun [Translator's note: so in the source; in ishtighāl the concealed verb is ordinarily indicated by the overt verb that follows]; the clause ﴿والموتى...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم إليه يرجعون﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرجعون; and يرجعون is an imperfect verb conjoined to the clause يبعثهم.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وقالوا لولا نزل عليه آية من ربه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); نزل is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نزل; آية is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; the clause ﴿لولا نزل...﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of their speech; and the clause ﴿وقالوا لولا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿قل إن الله قادر على أن ينزل آية﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the name of Majesty is its noun, and قادر is its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); على is a preposition, and ﴿إن﴾ [i.e. أن] with what is in its scope forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by على, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to قادر; and آية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ينزل.
﴿ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لكنّ is an abrogating particle, أكثرهم is its noun, لا is negative, and the clause يعلمون is its khabar; the sentence is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or the wāw is a conjunction and the sentence is conjoined to the object of the speech; or the wāw is resumptive and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وما من دابة في الأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ما is negative; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; دابة is a noun genitive by من in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the mubtadaʾ (subject); and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of دابة.
﴿ولا طائر يطير بجناحيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; طائر is a noun conjoined to دابة; and the clause يطير بجناحيه is an adjective of طائر.
﴿إلا أمم أمثالكم﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction; أمم is the khabar (predicate) of دابة; and أمثالكم is an adjective of أمم.
﴿ما فرطنا في الكتاب من شيء﴾: ما is negative; فرطنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); في الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فرطنا; من is a connective (redundant) preposition; شيء is genitive in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, as a maṣdar (i.e. absolute object) or as an object; and the clause ﴿ما فرطنا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم إلى ربهم يحشرون﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; إلى ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحشرون; and يحشرون is an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿ولو أننا نزلنا إليهم الملائكة وكلمهم الموتى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (لو) is conditional; ﴿أن﴾ and what lies within its scope are the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e. "it were established" (يثبت); the clause ﴿نزلنا إليهم الملائكة﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (أن); (كلّمهم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (نزلنا); and (الموتى) is the fāʿil.
﴿وحشرنا عليهم كل شيء قبلا﴾: the wāw is likewise conjunctive; (حشرنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (نزلنا); (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حشرنا); (كل شيء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (قبلًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "group upon group", or "as guarantors".
﴿ما كانوا ليؤمنوا إلا أن يشاء الله﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; (ما) is negating; (كانوا) is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); (يؤمنوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an "an" necessarily implied after the lām of denial; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted which is the khabar (predicate), i.e. "they were not fit for faith"; (إلا) is a particle of exception from the most general of states, so it is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil), the meaning being "they would not believe in any state at all except in the state of Allah's willing", so ﴿إنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has (أن)] and what follows it are a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or it is an exception from the most general of times, so the maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, i.e. "except at the time of Allah's willing"; or an exception from a general cause, i.e. "they would not believe for any reason at all except for Allah's willing faith", so it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and "an" with what it enters upon is interpreted as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "but Allah's will comes to pass". The clause ﴿ولو أننا نزلنا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن أكثرهم يجهلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; (لكن) is an abrogating particle; (أكثرهم) is its noun; the clause (يجهلون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا شياطين الإنس والجن﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, the implied form being "a making like that We made" (جعلًا مثلَ ذلك جعلنا); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿جعلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it takes two objects; ﴿لكل نبي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿عدوًّا﴾ is the second object of (جعلنا); and ﴿شياطين الإنس والجن﴾ is the first object of (جعلنا).
﴿يوحي بعضهم إلى بعض زخرف القول غرورا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿يوحي﴾ is an imperfect verb; (بعضهم) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوحي﴾. ﴿زخرف﴾ القول is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غرورًا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "in order to deceive them"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "deceiving"; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because (يوحي) has the sense of "deceives".
﴿ولو شاء ربك ما فعلوه فذرهم وما يفترون﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لو) is conditional; (شاء ربك) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is the protasis (sharṭ) of (لو), its object omitted; the clause (ما فعلوه) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); (ذرهم) is an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is conjunctive, and (ما) is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ in ﴿فذرهم﴾, i.e. "leave them and leave what they fabricate"; or the wāw means "with" and ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. "leave them and leave their fabrication".

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿ولتصغى إليه أفئدة الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is causal (for taʿlīl); (تصغى) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām; "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿غرورًا﴾; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تصغى); (أفئدة) is the fāʿil (agent) of (تصغى); (الذين) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (لا يؤمنون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (بالآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون).
﴿وليرضوه وليقترفوا ما هم مقترفون﴾: also conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿غرورًا﴾; the lām is causal (for taʿlīl), and the verbs after it are accusative by ﴿أن﴾ optionally implied after it; or the lām is the lām of becoming (al-ṣayrūra), or of outcome (al-ʿāqiba).

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿أفغير الله أبتغي حكما﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to something implied that the context of the speech requires, i.e. "say to them: shall I incline to the adornments of this world and so seek a judge?"; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and it is the maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying) of an omitted verb of saying, the clause of saying being resumptive with no grammatical position; (غير الله) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before (أبتغي); (حكمًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a tamyīz (specification), or a mafʿūl bihi, with ﴿غير﴾ as a ḥāl of ﴿حكمًا﴾, because it was originally its adjective.
﴿وهو الذي أنزل إليكم الكتاب مفصلا﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is a ḥāl corroborating the disapproval; (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) is the khabar (predicate); the clause (أنزل) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; (إليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل); (الكتاب) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (مفصلًا) is a ḥāl of (الكتاب).
﴿والذين آتيناهم الكتاب يعلمون أنه منزل من ربك بالحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (الذين) is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آتيناهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (الكتاب) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يعلمون) is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun; (أنّ) is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun and (منزل) is its khabar, and it stands in place of the two objects of (يعلمون); (من ربك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (منزل); (بالحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative pronoun in ﴿منزل﴾; and ﴿الذي﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no ﴿الذي﴾ in this phrase, and the nāʾib fāʿil of the passive participle (منزل) is the pronoun latent in it.]
﴿فلا تكونن من الممترين﴾: the fāʾ in ﴿فلا﴾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "if you know this and are certain of it, then do not be"; (لا) is prohibitive; (تكونن) is a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive (لا); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta" (you); and ﴿من الممترين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿وتمت كلمت ربك صدقا وعدلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (كلمة ربك) is the fāʿil (agent) of (تمت); (صدقًا) and (عدلًا) are a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (كلمة), or a ḥāl of ﴿ربك﴾, i.e. "truthful and just"; or a tamyīz (specification); or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "with truth and justice"; or two adjectives (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a completion of truth and justice".
﴿لا مبدل لكلماته﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (تمت), or resumptive with no grammatical position; (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (مبدل) is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; and ﴿لكلماته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿لا﴾.
﴿وهو السميع العليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (السميع) is a first khabar (predicate); (العليم) is a second khabar; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿وإن تطع أكثر من في الأرض يضلوك عن سبيل الله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إن) is conditional; (تطع) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (أكثر) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. (يضلوك) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and (عن سبيل الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضلوك).
﴿إن يتبعون إلا الظن﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is negating; (يتّبعون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (الظن) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإن هم إلا يخرصون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is negating; (هم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause (يخرصون) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿إن ربك هو أعلم من يضل عن سبيله﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (أعلم) the khabar (predicate), the clause being the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and (أعلم) is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; (من) is a relative noun, accusative by an implied verb, the implied form being "He knows who goes astray" (يعلم من يضل); the clause (يضل) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and (عن سبيله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يضل).
﴿وهو أعلم بالمهتدين﴾: (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أعلم) is the khabar (predicate); and (بالمهتدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم).

muyesser-irab:118-118.t: ﴿فكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه إن كنتم بآياته مؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition, the implied form being "if you are truly established in faith, then eat"; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا); the clause (ذكر اسم الله عليه) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (اسم الله) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (ذكر); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذكر); (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a defective past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun and (مؤمنين) is its khabar (predicate); (بآياته) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مؤمنين); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e. "then eat".

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿والذين كذبوا بآياتنا صم وبكم في الظلمات﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا; صم is the khabar (predicate), and بكم is conjoined to صم; and في الظلمات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second khabar.
﴿من يشأ الله يضلله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; يشأ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and يضلله its apodosis (jawāb); ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, and it is the content of the requital, i.e. "his being led astray"; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿ومن يشأ يجعله على صراط مستقيم﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause; the object of the willing is omitted, and it is the content of the requital, i.e. "his guidance".

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿قل أرأيتكم﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿أرأيتكم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative; رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the kāf is a particle of address indicating the variation of the one addressed, while the tāʾ is always with fatḥa in all its cases; رأى means "to know" or "to see" in the sense of informing; the first object in this ayah is omitted, its implied form being "have you considered it", i.e. the punishment; and the second is the interrogative clause, namely ﴿أغير الله تدعون﴾.
﴿إن أتاكم عذاب الله﴾: إن is conditional; أتاكم is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عذاب الله is the fāʿil.
﴿أو أتتكم الساعة﴾: أو is a conjunction, and أتتكم الساعة is conjoined to أتاكم; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then whom would you call upon?", or its implied form being "then tell me about it: would you call upon other than Allah to remove it?" ﴿أغير الله تدعون إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative; غير الله is a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تدعون; إن is conditional; كنتم is an incomplete past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and صادقين is its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis of إن is omitted, i.e. "if you are truthful that the idols benefit you, then call upon them".

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿بل إياه تدعون فيكشف ما تدعون إليه إن شاء وتنسون ما تشركون﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; إياه is a detached pronoun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تدعون; فيكشف is conjoined to تدعون; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the object of يكشف, and the clause تدعون إليه is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; إن is conditional, شاء is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted because the meaning is understood and what precedes it indicates it; the wāw is a conjunction, and تنسون is conjoined to تدعون; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause تشركون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا إلى أمم من قبلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the oath sentence is a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إلى أمم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا; من قبلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمم; and the clause قد أرسلنا has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the omitted oath.
﴿فأخذناهم بالبأساء والضراء لعلهم يتضرعون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخذناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined to something omitted, its implied form being "so they denied, and We seized them"; بالبأساء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أخذناهم﴾; الضراء is conjoined to His word بالبأساء; لعلّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يتضرعون is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿فلولا إذ جاءهم بأسنا تضرعوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لولا is a particle of rebuke and of making regret; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تضرعوا; the clause ﴿جاءهم﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and بأسنا is the fāʿil (agent) of تضرعوا [Translator's note: so in the source; بأسنا is the fāʿil of جاءهم, the fāʿil of تضرعوا being the wāw].
﴿ولكن قست قلوبهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لكن is lightened from the heavy [لكنّ] and is inoperative (muhmala), so it is merely for rectification (istidrāk); قست قلوبهم is a past verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the state being that they continued as they were in hardness and coarseness of nature".
﴿وزين لهم الشيطان ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; زين is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زين; الشيطان is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; the wāw is the noun of كان, and the clause يعملون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به فتحنا عليهم أبواب كل شيء﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya); نسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause نسوا is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ذكروا is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذكروا; فتحنا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فتحنا; أبواب is the mafʿūl bihi; and كل شيء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿حتى إذا فرحوا بما أوتوا أخذناهم بغتة﴾: حتى is inceptive or of limit; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to أخذناهم; the clause فرحوا is in the position of genitive by annexation; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فرحوا; the clause أوتوا is the ṣila with no grammatical position; أوتوا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أخذناهم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿أخذناهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and ﴿بغتة﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "taking [them] by surprise", or a ḥāl from the object, i.e. "taken by surprise".
﴿فإذا هم مبلسون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is [the إذا] of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is a particle; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مبلسون the khabar (predicate); and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿فقطع دابر القوم الذين ظلموا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قطع is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); دابر is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); القوم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as a naʿt (adjective) of القوم; and the clause ظلموا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿والحمد لله رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject); لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); رب is a naʿt or a badal (substitute), and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم إن أخذ الله سمعكم وأبصاركم وختم على قلوبكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you, O Muhammad"; the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīr); رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the first object of رأيتم is omitted, its implied form being "have you considered your hearing and your sight, if Allah took them away?"; and the interrogative clause that comes, namely ﴿مَن إله﴾, is in the place of the second object; إن is conditional; أخذ is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted; سمعكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and أبصاركم is conjoined; the clause ختم is conjoined; and على قلوبكم [a preposition and its genitive noun] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ختم.
﴿من إله غير الله يأتيكم به﴾: من is an interrogative noun of rebuke, the mubtadaʾ (subject); إله is its khabar (predicate); غير الله is a naʿt (adjective); the clause يأتيكم is a second adjective; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتيكم.
﴿انظر كيف نصرف الآيات﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; انظر is an imperative verb; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it has suspended ﴿انظر﴾ from governing; the clause نصرف الآيات is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ثم هم يصدفون﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and the clause يصدفون the khabar.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قل أرأيتكم﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿أرأيتكم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative; رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the kāf is a particle of address indicating the variation of the one addressed, while the tāʾ is always with fatḥa in all its cases; رأى means "to know" or "to see" in the sense of informing; the first object in this ayah is omitted, its implied form being "have you considered it", i.e. the punishment; and the second is the interrogative clause, namely ﴿هل يهلك إلا القوم الظالمون﴾.
﴿إن أتاكم عذاب الله بغتة أو جهرة﴾: إن is conditional; أتاكم is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عذاب الله is the fāʿil; بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and جهرة is conjoined to بغتة.
﴿هل يهلك إلا القوم الظالمون﴾: هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; يهلك is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); إلا is a particle of restriction; القوم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الظالمون a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وما نرسل المرسلين إلا مبشرين ومنذرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; نرسل المرسلين is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction; مبشرين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and منذرين is conjoined to مبشرين.
﴿فمن آمن وأصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); آمن is a past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and أصلح is conjoined to it; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is an inoperative (muhmala) negative; خوف is a mubtadaʾ, and beginning with it although it is indefinite is permissible because the negation precedes it; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; هم: mubtadaʾ. يحزنون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿لا خوف عليهم﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; and the clause of the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾. Or ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, in keeping with what follows it, so it is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا خوف عليهم﴾ is the khabar of the relative noun, the fāʾ being brought in because of the scent of condition in the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿والذين كذبوا بآياتنا يمسهم العذاب بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا; the clause يمسهم العذاب is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun. ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما كانوا﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يمسهم﴾, i.e. "because of their transgression"; كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and the clause يفسقون its khabar; and the clause ﴿والذين كذبوا...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿قل لا أقول لكم عندي خزائن الله﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb; لا is negative; أقول is an imperfect verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقول; the clause لا أقول is the object of the first speech (maqūl al-qawl); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقول [Translator's note: the source repeats this statement]; عندي is an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); خزائن الله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the second speech.
﴿ولا أعلم الغيب ولا أقول لكم إني ملك﴾: the clause ﴿ولا أعلم الغيب﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿عندي خزائن الله﴾, because it is part of the object of the speech; the clause ﴿لا أقول لكم إني ملك﴾ is conjoined to the first clause ﴿لا أقول لكم﴾. ﴿إني ملك﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun and ملك its khabar, and it too is the object of the speech.
﴿إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي﴾: the clause falls within the scope of the object of the speech, which has not yet ended; إن is negative; إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يوحى is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); and إلي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يوحى.
﴿قل هل يستوي الأعمى والبصير﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation, i.e. "they are not equal"; يستوي is an imperfect verb, الأعمى is its fāʿil (agent), and البصير is conjoined to الأعمى; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿أفلا تتفكرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is negative; and تتفكرون is conjoined to something implied and omitted, its implied form being: "i.e. they do not listen to this speech that is recited to you, so you do not reflect on it and discern its consequences".

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وأنذر به الذين يخافون أن يحشروا إلى ربهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنذر is an imperative verb; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنذر; الذين is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يخافون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it is interpreted as [a maṣdar,] the object of يخافون.
﴿ليس لهم من دونه ولي ولا شفيع﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in أن يحشروا, i.e. "warn by it those who fear the gathering, in the state that they have no protector to befriend them and no helper, and no intercessor to intercede for them besides Allah"; ﴿ليس﴾ is an incomplete past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ليس; من دونه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; ولي is the noun of ليس; and لا شفيع is conjoined to ولي.
﴿لعلهم يتقون﴾: لعلّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يتقون its khabar; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغداة والعشي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تطرد is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الذين is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position; ربهم is the mafʿūl bihi; بالغداة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يدعون; and العشي is conjoined to الغداة.
﴿يريدون وجهه﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of يدعون, i.e. "they call upon [Him] sincerely"; and وجهه is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ما عليك من حسابهم من شيء﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negative and non-governing; ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من حسابهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿شيء﴾. ﴿من شيء﴾: من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and شيء is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position; and the clause ما عليك… etc. is also a ḥāl.
﴿وما من حسابك عليهم من شيء فتطردهم فتكون من الظالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is negative and non-governing; ﴿من حسابك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿شيء﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿من شيء﴾: من is a connective (redundant) preposition, and شيء is the postponed mubtadaʾ, genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form and nominative in position. ﴿فتطردهم﴾: the fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and it is the answer to the negation; تطردهم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the causative fāʾ, and أن with the verb after it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding negation, i.e. "there is no accountability [of you for them], and [so no] driving away". ﴿فتكون﴾: the fāʾ is also causative, and it is the answer to the prohibition; or the second fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿تكون﴾ is conjoined to تطردهم by way of causation, because his being unjust is caused by driving them away; and ﴿من الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿وما لكم ألا تأكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; (أن لا تأكلوا) is an interpreted maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in that you do not eat", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to what ﴿لكم﴾ is attached to, it being the khabar of the interrogative ﴿ما﴾; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأكلوا); and the clause (ذكر اسم الله عليه) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقد فصل لكم ما حرم عليكم إلا ما اضطررتم إليه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (فصل) is a past verb with a latent fāʿil (agent); (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فصَّل); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (حرم عليكم) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (إلا) is a particle of exception; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the excepted in a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), and the clause (اضطررتم إليه) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or the exception is from the pronoun of ﴿حرّم﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival) in the sense of duration, i.e. "the things that were forbidden to you except under compulsion to them", so the exception is connected (muttaṣil), and the clause ﴿اضطررتم﴾ has no grammatical position; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اضطررتم), which is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the whole clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن كثيرا ليضلون بأهوائهم بغير علم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle; (كثيرا) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause ﴿يضلون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (بأهوائهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يضلون); and (بغير علم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clothed in ignorance".
﴿إن ربك هو أعلم بالمعتدين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) or a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); (أعلم) is the khabar (predicate) of (هو), or the khabar of (إن); and (بالمعتدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم).

muyesser-irab:120-120.t:
﴿وذروا ظاهر الإثم وباطنه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, joining to what precedes; (ذروا) is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ظاهر الإثم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (باطنه) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ظاهر).
﴿إن الذين يكسبون الإثم سيجزون بما كانوا يقترفون﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (الذين) is its noun; the clause (يكسبون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (الإثم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (سيجزون) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجزون﴾; the clause (كانوا) is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (كانوا) is a defective, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun and the clause (يقترفون) is its khabar; and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "they earn it" (يقترفونه).

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿ولا تأكلوا مما لم يذكر اسم الله عليه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تأكلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تأكلوا); (لم) is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; (يذكر) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم); (اسم الله) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (يذكر); and (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يذكر).
﴿وإنه لفسق﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (فسق) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); and the pronoun in ﴿إنه﴾ refers to the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb on which the particle of prohibition entered, i.e. the eating, or to ﴿ما﴾, i.e. to that over which the naming was omitted.
﴿وإن الشياطين ليوحون إلى أوليائهم ليجادلوكم﴾: the wāw conjoins to ﴿وإنه لفسق﴾, or is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; (الشياطين) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause (يوحون) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; (إلى أوليائهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يوحون); the lām is causal (for taʿlīl); (يجادلوكم) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām; "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are likewise attached to ﴿يوحون﴾.
﴿وإن أطعتموهم إنكم لمشركون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إن) is conditional; (أطعتموهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil and the wāw is for prolonging the ḍamma; (إن) is an abrogating particle and the kāf is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; and (مشركون) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿أومن كان ميتا فأحييناه وجعلنا له نورا يمشي به في الناس﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); the wāw conjoins to a clause drawn from His saying ﴿وإن أطعتموهم﴾, the implied form being "are you then like them?" (أأنتم مثلهم); (من) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (ميتًا) is the khabar (predicate) of kāna; ﴿فأحييناه﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and (أحييناه) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (جعلنا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His saying (فأحييناه); (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted second object of (جعلنا); and (نورًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi. Or ﴿جعلنا﴾ means "We created", and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿له﴾ are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿نورًا﴾, with ﴿نورًا﴾ as mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿يمشي﴾ is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نورًا﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمشي﴾; and ﴿في الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of (يمشي), i.e. "being among them".
﴿كمن مثله في الظلمات ليس بخارج منها﴾: ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿مثله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿في الظلمات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; the nominal clause ﴿مثله في الظلمات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿ليس بخارج منها﴾ is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb, its noun latent; ﴿بخارج﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and (خارج) is genitive by the bāʾ in wording and accusative in position as the khabar of (ليس); and ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خارج).
﴿كذلك زين للكافرين ما كانوا يعملون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with an adorning like that, their deeds were made to seem fair to the disbelievers"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿زين﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿للكافرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زين﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿كانوا﴾: (كان) is an abrogating verb and the wāw of the group is the noun of kāna; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of kāna; and the clause ﴿كانوا يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿وكذلك جعلنا في كل قرية أكابر مجرميها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or the wāw conjoins to what precedes; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, the implied form being "a making like that We made..." (جعلًا مثلَ ذلك جعلنا...); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿جعلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of (جعلنا); ﴿قرية﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أكابر﴾ is the first object of (جعلنا); and ﴿مجرميها﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ليمكروا فيها﴾: the lām is causal (for taʿlīl), or for outcome and becoming (al-ʿāqiba wa-l-ṣayrūra); (يمكروا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an"; "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعلنا); and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يمكروا).
﴿وما يمكرون إلا بأنفسهم وما يشعرون﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); (ما) is negating; (يمكرون) is an imperfect verb, and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of (يمكروا); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بأنفسهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يمكرون); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ما) is negating; and the clause (ما يشعرون) is in the position of the accusative [Translator's note: the source omits "as a ḥāl" here] of the pronoun of (يمكرون).

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿وإذا جاءتهم آية قالوا لن نؤمن حتى نؤتى مثل ما أوتي رسل الله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إذا) is an adverb of future time attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قالوا); the clause (جاءتهم) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); (آية) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (قالوا) has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; (لن) is a particle of negation, of the accusative and of the future; (نؤمن) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (لن), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (نؤتى) is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), accusative by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after (حتى); "an" and what follows it are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (نؤمن); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; (مثل) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa; the clause (أوتي) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and (رسل الله) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿الله أعلم حيث يجعل رسالته﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (أعلم) is its khabar (predicate); (حيث) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of a verb indicated by ﴿أعلم﴾, i.e. "He knows the place fit for placing His message"; a figurative adverb, with ﴿أعلم﴾ containing the sense of a word that passes to an adverb, the implied form being "Allah is most penetrating in knowledge where He places", i.e. His knowledge penetrates this place in which He places His message; the clause (يجعل رسالته) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); and (رسالته) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿سيصيب الذين أجرموا صغار عند الله وعذاب شديد بما كانوا يمكرون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of the future; (يصيب) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (أجرموا) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (صغار) is the fāʿil (agent); (عند الله) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصيب), or an adjective (ṣifa) of (صغار), i.e. "established with Allah"; (عذاب شديد) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (صغار); the bāʾ is a preposition of causation; (ما) is maṣdariyya (infinitival) or a relative; the clause (كانوا) has no grammatical position; and the clause (يمكرون) is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of (كانوا).

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿فمن يرد الله أن يهديه يشرح صدره للإسلام﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (من) is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (يرد) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and ﴿الله﴾ is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يهديه﴾ is accusative because it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "guidance"; (يشرح) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (صدره) is a mafʿūl bihi; (للإسلام) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشرح); and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾.
﴿ومن يرد أن يضله يجعل صدره ضيقا حرجا كأنما يصعد في السماء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿من﴾; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يضلّه﴾ is the object of ﴿يرد﴾; ﴿يرد﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿يجعل﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); ﴿صدره﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ضيقًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi; (حرجًا) is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿ضيقًا﴾; the simile clause ﴿كأنما﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (صدره), or of the pronoun latent in ﴿ضيقًا﴾; (أنما) [Translator's note: so in the source, i.e. (كأنما)] is the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يصّعَّد) is an imperfect verb; and (في السماء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصّعّد).
﴿كذلك يجعل الله الرجس على الذين لا يؤمنون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, the implied form being "a making like that He makes..."
