(جعلًا مثلَ ذلك يجعل...); (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يجعل﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الرجس﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يجعل﴾; ﴿على الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted second object of (يجعل); and the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وهذا صراط ربك مستقيما﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (صراط ربك) is the khabar (predicate); and (مستقيمًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) corroborating the clause, its governing element being the demonstrative.
﴿قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يذكرون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (فصلنا الآيات) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لقوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فصَّلنا); and the clause ﴿يذكرون﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿لهم دار السلام عند ربهم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, as though it came as the answer to someone asking what He has prepared for them, and that was said to him; or it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (يذكرون); (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (دار السلام) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and (عند ربهم) is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿دار السلام﴾, its governing element being the sense of settledness (istiqrār) latent in ﴿لهم﴾.
﴿وهو وليهم بما كانوا يعملون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (وليهم) is the khabar (predicate); the bāʾ is a causal preposition; (ما) is a relative noun or maṣdariyya (infinitival); the clause (كانوا) has no grammatical position; and the clause (يعملون) is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كانوا).

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿ويوم يحشرهم جميعا يا معشر الجن قد استكثرتم من الإنس﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (يوم) is an adverb, accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. "and remember the day We gather them" (واذكر يوم نحشرهم); the clause (نحشرهم) [Translator's note: so in the source, with nūn; the text above has (يحشرهم)] is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation) after the adverb; (جميعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or [(يوم) is] the object of an omitted "remember" (اذكر); (يا معشر الجن) is a vocative in a genitive construct (munādā muḍāf), the maqūl (object) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "and We say to them: O company of jinn"; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (استكثرتم) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿من الإنس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استكثرتم﴾.
﴿وقال أولياؤهم من الإنس ربنا استمتع بعضنا ببعض﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (قال أولياؤهم) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (من الإنس) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ربنا) is a vocative in a genitive construct (munādā muḍāf) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; (استمتع بعضنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (ببعض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استمتع); and the clause is in the position of the accusative [as the object] of the saying.
﴿وبلغنا أجلنا الذي أجلت لنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (بلغنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أجلنا) is an object; (الذي) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أجلنا﴾; the clause (أجلت) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and (لنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أجلت).
﴿قال النار مثواكم خالدين فيها﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قال) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) referring to ﴿الله﴾; (النار) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (مثواكم) is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (خالدين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in ﴿مثواكم﴾; and (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين).
﴿إلا ما شاء الله﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; and (ما) is a relative noun or maṣdariyya (infinitival), in the position of the accusative as the excepted.
﴿إن ربك حكيم عليم﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; (حكيم) is its first khabar (predicate); (عليم) is its second khabar; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it stands as a statement of cause (taʿlīl).

muyesser-irab:129-129.t: ﴿وكذلك نولي بعض الظالمين بعضا بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, the implied form being "with a placing-in-charge like that We place some of the wrongdoers over others"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نولي﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿بعض الظالمين﴾ is its first object; ﴿بعضًا﴾ is its second object, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "over some", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نولي); ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿نولي﴾; (كانوا) is a defective, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun and the clause (يكسبون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:130-130.t:
﴿يا معشر الجن والإنس ألم يأتكم رسل منكم﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle; (معشر الجن) is a vocative in a genitive construct (munādā muḍāf); the vocative clause is the maqūl (object) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "it will be said to them", and the omitted clause of saying is resumptive with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and rebuke; (لم) is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; (يأتكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (رسل) is a fāʿil (agent) placed after; and (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿يقصون عليكم آياتي﴾: the clause (يقصون) is a second adjective (ṣifa) of (رسل); (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقصون) or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (آياتي) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وينذرونكم لقاء يومكم هذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause (ينذرونكم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (يقصون); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لقاء) is a second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينذرونكم); (يومكم) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿هذا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of (يومكم), or a badal (substitute) of it.
﴿قالوا شهدنا على أنفسنا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿شهدنا على أنفسنا﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl (object) of their saying; and (على أنفسنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهدنا), i.e. "we have confessed and acknowledged".
﴿وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; ﴿غرتهم الحياة﴾ is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); (الدنيا) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is parenthetical with no grammatical position.
﴿وشهدوا على أنفسهم أنهم كانوا كافرين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; (شهدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (على أنفسهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهدوا); "anna" and what follows it are in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "that they were disbelievers" (بأنهم كانوا كافرين); the clause (كانوا) is the khabar (predicate) of "anna"; and (كافرين) is the khabar of (كانوا).

muyesser-irab:131-131.t:
﴿ذلك أن لم يكن ربك مهلك القرى بظلم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, standing as a statement of cause (taʿlīl); the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is what follows it, i.e. "that is established"; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is that"; (أن) is lightened from the heavy (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and together with what it enters upon it is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar, or attached to an omitted badal (substitute) of (ذلك) if ﴿ذلك﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; (لم) is a particle of negation; (يكن) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); the clause ﴿لم يكن...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿أن﴾; (ربك) is the noun of (يكن) and (مهلك القرى) is its khabar; and (بظلم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ذلك), i.e. "clothed in wrongdoing", or of the fāʿil (agent) of (مهلك), both having one meaning, or of (القرى), i.e. "clothed in their sins".
﴿وأهلها غافلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أهلها) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (غافلون) is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وكذلك فتنا بعضهم ببعض﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, the implied form being "and with a trial like that trial We tried some of them by others"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; بعضهم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ببعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فتنا; and the clause ﴿وكذلك فتنا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ليقولوا أهؤلاء من الله عليهم من بيننا﴾: the lām: for cause (taʿlīl), or for becoming (ṣayrūra), or for outcome (ʿāqiba). يقولوا: an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām. The concealed أن and the verb after it form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿فتنا﴾. The interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation and mockery. هؤلاء: a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مَنَّ الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مَنَّ﴾. The clause ﴿مَنَّ الله عليهم﴾: in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate).
﴿أليس الله بأعلم بالشاكرين﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation; ليس is an incomplete past verb, and ﴿الله﴾ is its noun; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; أعلم is genitive in form by the bāʾ and accusative in position as the khabar of ليس; بالشاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعلم; and the interrogative sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وإذا جاءك الذين يؤمنون بآياتنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, i.e. "then say: peace be upon you, at the time of their coming"; the clause جاءك is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position.
﴿فقل سلام عليكم﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); سلام is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿قل﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause سلام عليكم is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿وإذا جاءك الذين...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿كتب ربكم على نفسه الرحمة﴾: the clause falls within the scope of what is said, because it is part of what he says to them; كتب ربكم is a verb and its fāʿil; على نفسه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كتب; and الرحمة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أنه من عمل منكم سوءا بجهالة ثم تاب من بعده وأصلح فأنه غفور رحيم﴾: أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the sentence is arranged within the scope of the speech; من is a jussive conditional noun, or a relative noun, and it is a mubtadaʾ; عمل is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); سوءًا is the mafʿūl bihi; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of عمل; بجهالة is a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil, i.e. "he did it while ignorant of the reality of the harms that arise from it"; ثم is a conjunction; تاب is conjoined to عمل, and أصلح is also conjoined to it; the fāʾ links the apodosis; ﴿أن﴾ with what is in its scope is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then his affair and his outcome is Allah's forgiveness of him"; غفور رحيم are two khabars of ﴿أن﴾; the clause من عمل is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وكذلك نفصل الآيات ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "with a detailing like that We detail the signs"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نفصل﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); ﴿الآيات﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw conjoins to something omitted, the implied form being "so that the truth may appear and the way of the criminals may appear". ﴿لتستبين﴾: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); تستبين is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām of cause, and أن with the verb after it forms an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted after it, the implied form being "and so that their way may become clear, We detailed them"; the implied clause "We detailed them" is conjoined to the clause نفصِّل, with no grammatical position; ﴿سبيل﴾ is the fāʿil, and ﴿المجرمين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿قل إني نهيت أن أعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نهيت, the meaning being "I have been forbidden from worshipping those whom you call upon"; الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تدعون.
﴿قل لا أتبع أهواءكم قد ضللت إذا وما أنا من المهتدين﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿لا أتبع أهواءكم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; the clause ﴿قد ضللت﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital containing the sense of condition, the meaning being "if I followed your desires I would have gone astray and not been guided", so it has the force of a condition and its apodosis; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative that acts like ليس, ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿من المهتدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-governing negative, ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من المهتدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿قل إني على بينة من ربي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb; the clause ﴿إني على بينة﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿من ربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بينة﴾.
﴿وكذبتم به ما عندي ما تستعجلون به﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial, so the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and ﴿قد﴾ must then be implied; كذبتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تستعجلون [Translator's note: so in the source; the به that follows كذبتم would attach to كذبتم, the one attached to تستعجلون being the به at the end of the phrase]; ما is negative; عندي is an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause تستعجلون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ما عندي...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الحكم إلا لله يقص الحق﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is negative; الحكم is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of الحكم; the clause يقص الحق is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; and الحق is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهو خير الفاصلين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial; هو is the mubtadaʾ, and خير الفاصلين the khabar.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿قل لو أن عندي ما تستعجلون به لقضي الأمر بيني وبينكم﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; ﴿أن﴾ with what is in its scope is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "it were established" (ثبت); the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of أنّ; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the postponed noun of أنّ; the clause تستعجلون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تستعجلون; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; قضي is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and الأمر is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no position because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition; بيني is an adverb of place attached to قضي, and بينكم is also an adverb, conjoined to the preceding adverb.
﴿والله أعلم بالظالمين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), أعلم the khabar, and بالظالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعلم.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها إلا هو﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مفاتح الغيب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يعلمها is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from مفاتح, the governor of it being the [notion of] being-established to which the adverb is attached; إلا is a particle of restriction; and هو is the fāʿil (agent), or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil.
﴿ويعلم ما في البر والبحر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يعلم is an imperfect verb; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في البر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; البحر is conjoined to البر; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وما تسقط من ورقة إلا يعلمها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; تسقط is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ورقة is genitive in form by من and nominative in position as the fāʿil of تسقط; إلا is a particle of restriction; and the clause يعلمها is a ḥāl from ورقة.
﴿ولا حبة في ظلمات الأرض ولا رطب ولا يابس إلا في كتاب مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; حبة is conjoined to ورقة, genitive in form; لا رطب ولا يابس are also conjoined to ورقة; إلا is a particle of restriction; في كتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, and it is a repetition of His words إلا يعلمها, as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion), so it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وهو الذي يتوفاكم بالليل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause يتوفاكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); بالليل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتوفاكم.
﴿ويعلم ما جرحتم بالنهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يعلم is conjoined to يتوفاكم; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of يعلم; the clause جرحتم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of جرحتم [Translator's note: so in the source; on this view the interpreted maṣdar would be the object of يعلم].
﴿ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضى أجل مسمى﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; يبعثكم is conjoined to يتوفاكم; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبعثكم﴾; the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); يقضى is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), accusative by a concealed أن after the lām of cause, and أن with the verb after it forms an interpreted maṣdar in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿يبعثكم﴾; أجل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and مسمى a naʿt (adjective).
﴿ثم إليه مرجعكم ثم ينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: conjoined to the preceding sentence; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مرجعكم is the postponed mubtadaʾ; ثم ينبئكم is also conjoined; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينبئكم; the clause ﴿كنتم تعملون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila; and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وهو القاهر فوق عباده﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and القاهر its khabar (predicate); فوق is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being exalted above".
﴿ويرسل عليكم حفظة﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل, and حفظة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حفظة, because it is the plural of حافظ, which is an active participle, i.e. "He sends those who keep record of your deeds against you".
﴿حتى إذا جاء أحدكم الموت توفته رسلنا﴾: حتى is inceptive or of limit; إذا is a future adverb attached to توفته; the clause جاء is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; أحدكم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and الموت a postponed fāʿil (agent); and the clause توفته رسلنا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وهم لا يفرطون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يفرطون is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar, the sentence being a ḥāl; or the wāw is resumptive and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ثم ردوا إلى الله مولاهم الحق﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; ردوا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ردوا is conjoined to توفته; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ردوا; مولاهم is a badal (substitute) of ﴿الله﴾ or a naʿt (adjective) of it; and الحق is a naʿt of مولاهم.
﴿ألا له الحكم وهو أسرع الحاسبين﴾: ألا is a particle of drawing attention and of opening; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); الحكم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and أسرع الحاسبين its khabar; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قل من ينجيكم من ظلمات البر والبحر﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); من is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ينجيكم is the khabar (predicate); من ظلمات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينجيكم; the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); البر is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and البحر is conjoined to البر.
﴿تدعونه تضرعا وخفية﴾: the clause تدعونه is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in ينجيكم, i.e. "He saves you while you are calling upon Him"; تدعونه is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تضرعًا and خفية are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the place of a ḥāl from the wāw, i.e. "you call upon Him while humbly imploring and in secret", maṣdars from the meaning of the governor, not from its wording, like their saying: قعدت جلوسًا ("I sat down a sitting").
﴿لئن أنجانا من هذه لنكونن من الشاكرين﴾: the oath sentence is accusative by an implied speech, that speech being a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ﴿تدعونه﴾, i.e. "you call upon Him saying that"; or the oath sentence is explicative of the calling, with no grammatical position. The lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن is conditional; أنجانا is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "He" (هو), and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنجانا. ﴿لنكونن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and the clause نكونن من الشاكرين has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because it comes later; and من الشاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of نكونن.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قل الله ينجيكم منها﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ينجيكم its khabar (predicate); منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينجيكم, i.e. from the darknesses; and the nominal sentence is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ومن كل كرب ثم أنتم تشركون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من كل كرب is conjoined to the genitive pronoun; ثم is a conjunction; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause تشركون the khabar.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿قل هو القادر على أن يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم أو من تحت أرجلكم﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), القادر the khabar (predicate), and the nominal sentence is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); على is a preposition; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ﴿يبعث﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يبعث﴾ is genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) القادر; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يبعث; عذابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من فوقكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of His word ﴿عذابًا﴾; and أو من تحت أرجلكم is conjoined to His words من فوقكم.
﴿أو يلبسكم شيعا ويذيق بعضكم بأس بعض﴾: أو is a conjunction; يلبسكم is conjoined to يبعث; شيعًا is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); يذيق is conjoined to يلبس; بعضكم is the first object of يذيق, and بأس بعض the second object of يذيق.
﴿انظر كيف نصرف الآيات لعلهم يفقهون﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; نصرف is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); الآيات is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿كيف نصرف الآيات﴾ is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb ﴿انظر﴾. ﴿لعلهم﴾: لعلّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يفقهون its khabar; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وكذب به قومك﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or [Translator's note: so in the source, with "or" before the next statement] the pronoun refers to the Qurʾan; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذب; and قومك is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وهو الحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial; the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in ﴿به﴾, i.e. "while it is the truth".
﴿قل لست عليكم بوكيل﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿لست...﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ليس is an incomplete past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وكيل; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; and وكيل is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the khabar (predicate) of ليس.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t:
﴿ولكل درجات مما عملوا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لكل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first, the tanwīn in (كل) compensating for the muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "and for each party"; (درجات) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; ﴿مما﴾: (من) is a preposition and (ما) is maṣdariyya (infinitival) or a relative, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of (درجات); and the clause (عملوا) has no grammatical position.
﴿وما ربك بغافل عما يعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which works as laysa works; ﴿ربك﴾ is the noun of (ما); ﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and (غافل) is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in wording by the bāʾ; ﴿عما﴾: (عن) is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e. "of that which they do"; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿يعملون﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "of their deeds"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غافل﴾; and the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t:
﴿وربك الغني ذو الرحمة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿ربك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الغني) is a first khabar (predicate); and (ذو الرحمة) is a second khabar.
﴿إن يشأ يذهبكم ويستخلف من بعدكم ما يشاء﴾: the conditional clause is a third khabar (predicate); or ﴿الغني﴾ and ﴿ذو الرحمة﴾ are two adjectives (ṣifa) of ﴿ربك﴾ and the conditional clause is the khabar of ﴿ربك﴾; (إن) is conditional; (يشأ) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); (يذهبكم) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿ويستخلف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and (يستخلف) is an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (يذهبكم); (من بعدكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستخلف); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿كما أنشأكم من ذرية قوم آخرين﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "and He will make successors after you of whomever He wills, with a succession like His raising you"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival); ﴿أنشأكم﴾ is a past verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنشأكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and its ṣila is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من ذرية﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنشأكم); ﴿قوم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿آخرين﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿إن ما توعدون لآت﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿ما﴾ is its noun; the clause (توعدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and it is built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "[what you are promised] of it, of the Hour and the punishment"; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and (آت) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن).
﴿وما أنتم بمعجزين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which works as laysa works; ﴿أنتم﴾ is the noun of (ما); ﴿بمعجزين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿معجزين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in wording by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t:
﴿قل يا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (يا) is a vocative particle; (قوم) is a vocative annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (اعملوا) is an imperative verb; (على مكانتكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (إن) is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun and ﴿عامل﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the clause stands as a statement of cause (taʿlīl) for the command.
﴿فسوف تعلمون من تكون له عاقبة الدار﴾: the fāʾ is for causation (taʿlīl), and the clause is causal with no grammatical position; (من) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (تعلمون), and the clause ﴿تكون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; or ﴿من﴾ is interrogative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the clause (تكون), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of (تعلمون); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of (تكون), placed first; and (عاقبة الدار) is its noun, placed after.
﴿إنه لا يفلح الظالمون﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun; the clause (لا يفلح الظالمون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is likewise causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:136-136.t:
﴿وجعلوا لله مما ذرأ من الحرث والأنعام نصيبا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (جعلوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted which is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first object being (نصيبًا); (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نصيبًا﴾ and was placed before it; the clause (ذرأ) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (من الحرث) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, likewise of ﴿نصيبًا﴾; and (الأنعام) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (الحرث).
﴿فقالوا هذا لله بزعمهم وهذا لشركائنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قالوا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (جعلوا); the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (بزعمهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the [sense of] settledness (istiqrār) in His saying ﴿لله﴾ is attached to; and (هذا لشركائنا) is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, the clause being conjoined to ﴿هذا لله﴾.
﴿فما كان لشركائهم فلا يصل إلى الله﴾: the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿiyya), and the clause has no grammatical position because it stands as resumptive; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (كان) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (كان) is a defective past verb, its noun latent; (لشركائهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is a linking one, because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; (لا) is negating; and the clause (لا يصل إلى الله) is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وما كان لله فهو يصل إلى شركائهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (كان) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (كان) is a defective past verb, its noun latent; (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is a linking one; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; and the clause (يصل إلى شركائهم) is its khabar.
﴿ساء ما يحكمون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿ساء﴾ is an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), implied as ﴿هو﴾. ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite described noun (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification) of the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾; the clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿ما﴾; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, the implied form being "evil as a judgment is their judgment" (ساء حكمًا حكمهم).
Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun meaning "that which", in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "their judgment". The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival). The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and what it entered upon is the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, the implied form being "evil is their judging" (ساء حكمهم). And the one specified for blame is omitted.

muyesser-irab:137-137.t:
﴿وكذلك زين لكثير من المشركين قتل أولادهم شركاؤهم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with an adorning like that they adorned..."; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿زيّن﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa; ﴿لكثير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زيّن﴾; ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿كثير﴾; ﴿قتل﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; ﴿أولادهم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿شركاؤهم﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of (زيَّن), placed after.
﴿ليردوهم وليلبسوا عليهم دينهم﴾: the lām is causal (for taʿlīl); ﴿يردوهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām; "an" and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّن); ﴿وليلبسوا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ليردوهم); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يلبسوا); and ﴿دينهم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولو شاء الله ما فعلوه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿شاء الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) being omitted, i.e. "their not doing [it]"; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿فعلوه﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the nominative pronoun refers to ﴿كثير﴾ and the accusative pronoun refers to the killing.
﴿فذرهم وما يفترون﴾: ﴿فذرهم﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); (ذرهم) is an imperative verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction or for accompaniment (maʿiyya); and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun or maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. "leave them and the lies that they fabricate", or "leave them and their fabrication".

muyesser-irab:138-138.t:
﴿وقالوا هذه أنعام وحرث حجر لا يطعمها إلا من نشاء بزعمهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (هذه) is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أنعام) is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (حرث) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (أنعام); (حجر) is a description of both, i.e. "restricted, prohibited, forbidden"; the clause (لا يطعمها) is a second adjective (ṣifa) of (أنعام); (يطعمها) is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (من) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of (يطعمها); the clause (نشاء) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and (بزعمهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (قالوا), i.e. "they said that clothed in their false claim".
﴿وأنعام حرمت ظهورها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (أنعام) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "these"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His saying ﴿هذه أنعام﴾; the clause (حرمت ظهورها) is an adjective (ṣifa), i.e. "they are not ridden"; and (ظهورها) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (حرمت).
﴿وأنعام لا يذكرون اسم الله عليها افتراء عليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أنعام) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; the clause (لا يذكرون) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (أنعام); (اسم الله) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عليها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يذكرون); (افتراء) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "they did all that for the sake of fabrication"; or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "fabricating"; or a corroborative maṣdar (verbal noun), because that saying of theirs has the sense of fabrication; and (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افتراء), or to an omitted adjective of it.
﴿سيجزيهم بما كانوا يفترون﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يجزيهم); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival) or a relative; the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "because of their fabrication", or "because of that which they used to fabricate against Allah"; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun and the clause (يفترون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause (كانوا يفترون) has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿وقالوا ما في بطون هذه الأنعام خالصة لذكورنا ومحرم على أزواجنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (في بطون) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (هذه) is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); (الأنعام) is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; (خالصة) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; (لذكورنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خالصة); (محرم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (خالصة); and (على أزواجنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (محرّم).
﴿وإن يكن ميتة فهم فيه شركاء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (يكن) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the noun of (يكن) is latent, the implied form being "and if what is in their bellies is"; (ميتة) is the khabar (predicate); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿هم﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شركاء) is the khabar; and (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to (شركاء).
﴿سيجزيهم وصفهم﴾: a resumptive statement standing as a statement of cause (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of the future; (يجزيهم) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent, referring to Allah the Exalted; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (وصفهم) is the second mafʿūl bihi of (يجزيهم); and a muḍāf must be implied, the implied form being "He will recompense them with the recompense of their describing lies against Allah in permitting and forbidding".
﴿إنه حكيم عليم﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun; (حكيم عليم) are its two predicates; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t:
﴿قد خسر الذين قتلوا أولادهم سفها بغير علم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (خسر الذين) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause (قتلوا أولادهم) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (سفهًا) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of the lightness of their minds and their ignorance"; and (بغير علم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (قتلوا), i.e. "ignorant that Allah is the Provider for them and for their children".
﴿وحرموا ما رزقهم الله افتراء على الله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (حرموا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ما) is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿رزقهم الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (افتراء) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (افتراء).
﴿قد ضلوا وما كانوا مهتدين﴾: the clause is a tawkīd (emphasis) of His saying ﴿قد خسر الذين﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; ﴿كانوا مهتدين﴾: a defective, abrogating past verb, the wāw being its noun and (مهتدين) its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:141-141.t:
﴿وهو الذي أنشأ جنات معروشات وغير معروشات﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أنشأ) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (جنات) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (معروشات) is an adjective (ṣifa); and (غير معروشات) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (معروشات).
﴿والنخل والزرع مختلفا أكله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (النخل) and (الزرع) are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (جنات); (مختلفًا) is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara); and (أكله) is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿مختلفًا﴾, because it is an active participle.
﴿والزيتون والرمان متشابها وغير متشابه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; (متشابهًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (غير متشابه) is conjoined to it.
﴿كلوا من ثمره إذا أثمر وآتوا حقه يوم حصاده﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (كلوا) is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من ثمره) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا); (إذا) is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; (آتوا) is an imperative verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (كلوا), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (حقه) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يوم) is an adverb of time attached to (آتوا); and (حصاده) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا تسرفوا إنه لا يحب المسرفين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تسرفوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (إن) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يحب المسرفين﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of (إن) and what lies within its scope is a statement of cause (taʿlīl) for what precedes.

muyesser-irab:142-142.t:
﴿ومن الأنعام حمولة وفرشا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من الأنعام) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنشأ﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿حمولة وفرشا﴾, its origin being an adjective (naʿt) placed before the indefinite noun it qualifies, so it is parsed as a ḥāl; (حمولة) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (جنات), accusative; and (فرشا) is likewise conjoined to (جنات), the meaning being "and He produced of the livestock burden-bearers and small ones".
﴿كلوا مما رزقكم الله ولا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (كلوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا); the clause ﴿رزقكم الله﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبعوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (خطوات الشيطان) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause (كلوا).
﴿إنه لكم عدو مبين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (عدو) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (مبين) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:143-143.t:
﴿ثمانية أزواج من الضأن اثنين﴾: (ثمانية): a badal (substitute) of (حمولة) and (فرشًا), or accusative by ﴿كلوا مما رزقكم الله﴾, or by an implied ﴿أنشأ﴾. (أزواج): a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (من الضأن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿اثنين﴾, because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of it and was placed before it. (اثنين): a badal of (ثمانية أزواج).
﴿ومن المعز اثنين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿من الضأن اثنين﴾. (من المعز): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿اثنين﴾, because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of it and was placed before it. (اثنين): likewise a badal (substitute) of (ثمانية أزواج), because it is conjoined to a badal.
﴿قل آلذكرين حرم أم الأنثيين﴾: (قل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta" (you). The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and (الذكرين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before (حرّم). ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction, and (الأنثيين) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (الذكرين). The clause ﴿آلذكرين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying). The clause ﴿قل آلذكرين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أما اشتملت عليه أرحام الأنثيين﴾: the second ﴿أم﴾ is conjunctive; it conjoins the relative ﴿ما﴾ after it to (الأنثيين), so it is in the position of the accusative.
﴿نبئوني بعلم إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the clause is likewise resumptive, with no grammatical position. (نبئوني) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بعلم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نبئوني); (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a defective, abrogating past verb, the tāʾ being its noun, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (صادقين) is its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

muyesser-irab:144-144.t:
﴿ومن الإبل اثنين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿من الضأن اثنين﴾. (من الإبل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿اثنين﴾, because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of it and was placed before it. (اثنين): likewise a badal (substitute) of (ثمانية أزواج), because it is conjoined to a badal.
﴿ومن البقر اثنين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿من الضأن اثنين﴾. (من البقر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿اثنين﴾, because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of it and was placed before it. (اثنين): likewise a badal (substitute) of (ثمانية أزواج), because it is conjoined to a badal.
﴿قل آلذكرين حرم أم الأنثيين﴾: (قل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta" (you). The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and (الذكرين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before (حرّم). ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction, and (الأنثيين) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (الذكرين). The clause ﴿آلذكرين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying). The clause ﴿قل آلذكرين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أما اشتملت عليه أرحام الأنثيين﴾: the second ﴿أم﴾ is conjunctive; it conjoins the relative ﴿ما﴾ after it to (الأنثيين), so it is in the position of the accusative.
﴿أم كنتم شهداء إذ وصاكم الله بهذا﴾: (أم): disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), in the sense of "bal" (rather) plus the hamza, the implied form being "rather, were you ...?" (بل أكنتم ...؟), and it is an interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); (إذ): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهداء); the clause ﴿وصاكم الله﴾ is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); and ﴿بهذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وصاكم).
﴿فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "if you know this and it is firmly fixed in your minds"; (من) is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) is the khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, and the interrogative means negation, i.e. "no one is more wrongdoing"; (ممن) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم); the clause (افترى) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى); and ﴿كذبا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (افترى), i.e. "he fabricated a lie and contrived it"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he fabricated for the sake of lying"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he fabricated while being a liar", and it is a corroborative ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida).
﴿ليضل الناس بغير علم﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an"; "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (افترى); (الناس) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (بغير علم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of (افترى), i.e. "he fabricated against Him, the Exalted".
﴿إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of (إن) here is the Divine Name (الله)]; the clause (لا يهدي) is its khabar (predicate); (القوم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الظالمين) is an adjective (naʿt) of (القوم); and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿لكل نبأ مستقر وسوف تعلمون﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); نبأ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); مستقر is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction; سوف is a particle of the future; and تعلمون is an imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿وإذا رأيت الذين يخوضون في آياتنا﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, which is ﴿فأعرض عنهم﴾; رأيت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the seeing here is visual, and an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) must be implied, i.e. "when you see those who engage in Our signs, being occupied in engaging in them"; or the seeing is mental (qalbiyya), and the second object is omitted for brevity; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يخوضون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and في آياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يخوضون﴾.
﴿فأعرض عنهم حتى يخوضوا في حديث غيره﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أعرض is an imperative verb; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; يخوضوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after حتى, and the concealed أن with the verb after it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أعرض; ﴿في حديث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يخوضوا﴾; غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of حديث, and the pronoun refers to the signs.
﴿وإما ينسينك الشيطان فلا تقعد بعد الذكرى مع القوم الظالمين﴾: the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is conditional, and ما is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), into which the nūn of ﴿إن﴾ has been assimilated; ينسيك [Translator's note: so written in the source, for ينسينّ] is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is the object of ينسينك, and الشيطان its fāʿil; the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is prohibitive; تقعد is an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive لا; بعد الذكرى is an adverb of time attached to ﴿تقعد﴾; مع is an adverb of place also attached to ﴿تقعد﴾; القوم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and الظالمين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿وما على الذين يتقون من حسابهم من شيء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the sentence is conjoined; or the wāw is resumptive and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is negative; على الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause يتقون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; من حسابهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and شيء is genitive in form by من and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولكن ذكرى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is lightened and inoperative (muhmala); ذكرى is accusative as a maṣdar (i.e. absolute object) by a concealed verb, i.e. "but they remind them with a reminding"; or nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is a reminder"; or it is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, i.e. "but upon them is a reminding".
﴿لعلهم يتقون﴾: لعلّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يتقون its khabar; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿وذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعبا ولهوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; دينهم is the first object of اتخذوا, لعبًا the second object, and لهوًا is conjoined to it; or اتخذوا means "acquired", so it is transitive to one object, ﴿لعبًا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and ﴿لهوًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لعبا﴾.
﴿وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the clause is conjoined, and it is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi, a fāʿil and a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وذكر به أن تبسل نفس بما كسبت ليس لها من دون الله ولي ولا شفيع﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذكر is an imperative verb; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذكر; ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. "for fear that it be surrendered to punishment and perdition"; the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما كسبت﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تبسل﴾; the clause of ليس with what is in its scope is an adjective of نفس, or resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ولي is the noun of ليس, and شفيع is conjoined to ولي.
﴿وإن تعدل كل عدل لا يؤخذ منها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تعدل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كل عدل is accusative as a maṣdar (i.e. absolute object); لا is negative; يؤخذ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); منها is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يؤخذ. It is not permissible for the deputy agent to be a pronoun referring to the ransom (al-ʿadl), because it is not an object of تعدل; otherwise the implied form of the speech would be "and if it offered every ransom with…" (وإن تعدل بكل عدل), since تعدل reaches its object through the bāʾ.
﴿أولئك الذين أبسلوا بما كسبوا﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذين its khabar; the clause ﴿أبسلوا﴾ is the ṣila with no grammatical position; بما كسبوا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أبسلوا﴾; and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. "because of their earning".
﴿لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; شراب is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم شراب﴾ is a second khabar, or a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position; من حميم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of شراب; عذاب is conjoined to شراب, and أليم is a naʿt.
﴿بما كانوا يكفرون﴾: ما is maṣdariyya; كانوا is an incomplete past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; the wāw is the noun (ism) of كان]; ﴿ما كانوا﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "[it] has been prepared for them", so it serves as an explanation of أبسلوا; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يكفرون﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قل أندعو من دون الله ما لا ينفعنا ولا يضرنا﴾: قل: an imperative verb, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿قل﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿أندعو﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; ندعو is an imperfect verb, and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ندعو; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of ندعو; the clause ﴿لا ينفعنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause ولا يضرنا conjoined to it.
﴿ونرد على أعقابنا بعد إذ هدانا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نرد is an imperfect verb conjoined to ندعو, falling under the ruling of denial and negation, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); على أعقابنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "returning to polytheism after Allah rescued us from it"; بعد is an adverb attached to ﴿نرد﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿هدانا الله﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and هدانا الله is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil.
﴿كالذي استهوته الشياطين في الأرض حيران﴾: ﴿كالذي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the latent deputy agent of ﴿نُرَد﴾, i.e. "we are turned back resembling the one whom the devils have enticed"; ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿استهوته الشياطين﴾ is the ṣila with no grammatical position; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استهوته; and ﴿حيران﴾ is a ḥāl from the object of استهوته.
﴿له أصحاب يدعونه إلى الهدى ائتنا﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿أصحاب﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun of حيران, or resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يدعونه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أصحاب; ﴿إلى الهدى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدعونه; ﴿ائتنا﴾ is an imperative verb, and نا is its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted speech, i.e. "they say: come to us", and the clause of saying is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿قل إن هدى الله هو الهدى﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and هدى is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ, and الهدى its khabar; the nominal sentence is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ; and the clause of ﴿إن﴾ with what is in its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿وأمرنا لنسلم لرب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أمرنا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the deputy agent; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن هدى الله هو الهدى﴾, arranged within the scope of the speech. ﴿لنسلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no wāw in ﴿لنسلم﴾]; the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), so it gives the reason for the command, the implied form being "we were commanded with what we were commanded for the sake of submitting"; نسلم is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām, and أن with the verb forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the lām, the lām and its genitive being attached to ﴿أُمرنا﴾. It has been said: the lām in ﴿لنسلم﴾ is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and the verb after it is accusative by an implied ﴿أن﴾ after the lām, the implied form being "and we were commanded to submit" (وأُمرنا أن نُسلم), on the assumption of the genitive bāʾ, i.e. "with [the command] that we submit" (بأن نُسلم). ﴿لرب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نسلم﴾, and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وأن أقيموا الصلاة واتقوه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "and we were commanded with [the command]: establish the prayer"; the conjoined clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) by the speech, coordinated with His words: إن هدى الله هو الهدى, i.e. "say these two things"; or it is coordinated with ﴿لنسلم﴾, the implied form being "we were commanded such-and-such for submission and so that we establish the prayer"; أقيموا is an imperative verb, الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and اتقوه is conjoined to أقيموا.
﴿وهو الذي إليه تحشرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause تحشرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي with no grammatical position; and إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحشرون.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وهو الذي خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause خلق السماوات والأرض is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in truth and earnest, not jesting nor playing".
﴿ويوم يقول كن فيكون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause يقول is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; كن is a complete (tāmm), not incomplete, imperative verb, so it is content with its nominative; the fāʿil (agent) of كن is a pronoun; the fāʾ is a conjunction; and يكون is a complete imperfect verb conjoined to كن.
﴿قوله الحق﴾: a mubtadaʾ and a khabar, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وله الملك يوم ينفخ في الصور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الملك is the postponed mubtadaʾ; يوم is an adverb of time attached to something omitted, a badal (substitute) of the first adverb in His words ﴿يوم يقول﴾; the clause ينفخ is in the position of genitive by annexation; and في الصور is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ينفخ.
﴿عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: عالم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the wāw is a conjunction, and الشهادة is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿وهو الحكيم الخبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; هو is a detached pronoun, the mubtadaʾ; الحكيم الخبير are two khabars; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿وإذ قال إبراهيم لأبيه آزر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿اذكر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿قل أندعو﴾, i.e. "and remember to Quraysh — after you have denounced to them the worship of what neither benefits nor harms — the time when Ibrāhīm, whose religion they claim to follow, spoke"; the clause ﴿قال إبراهيم﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; لأبيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال; and آزر is a badal (substitute) of أبيه.
﴿أتتخذ أصناما آلهة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); أصنامًا is the first object of تتخذ, and آلهة the second object.
﴿إني أراك وقومك في ضلال مبين﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أراك its khabar (predicate); the sentence gives the reason for the denial; قومك: conjoined to the kāf, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); في ضلال is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the second object if the seeing is mental (qalbiyya), or a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) if the seeing is visual; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿وكذلك نري إبراهيم ملكوت السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive, or parenthetical. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a showing like that We show Ibrāhīm"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; إبراهيم is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ملكوت السماوات والأرض is the second object; the clause ﴿وكذلك نري إبراهيم ...﴾ is conjoined, or the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive, or parenthetical between His words ﴿وإذ قال﴾ and the reasoning to that in His words ﴿فلما جن عليه الليل﴾.
﴿وليكون من الموقنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what it conjoins is omitted, i.e. "and We did that so that he might be…"; so the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); يكون is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām of cause, and أن with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted conjoined [clause]; the noun of يكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and من الموقنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿فلما جن عليه الليل رأى كوكبا قال هذا ربي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the sentence is conjoined to the clause ﴿قال إبراهيم لأبيه﴾; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); جن is a past verb; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جن; الليل is the fāʿil (agent); the clause جن is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position on the second [view]; the clause ﴿رأى كوكبًا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿هذا ربي﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فلما أفل قال لا أحب الآفلين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفل is in the position of genitive by annexation, or has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause لا أحب الآفلين is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فلما رأى القمر بازغا قال هذا ربي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); رأى القمر is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بازغًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿ربي﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فلما أفل قال لئن لم يهدني ربي لأكونن من القوم الضالين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفل is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position. ﴿لئن﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يهدني is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ربي﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the lām is [that of] the answer to the oath, and the clause أكوننّ is the answer to the oath with no grammatical position; من القوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of أكونن; and الضالين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿فلما رأى الشمس بازغة قال هذا ربي هذا أكبر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); رأى الشمس is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بازغة is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿ربي﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿هذا أكبر﴾ is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the object of the speech; and the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فلما أفلت قال يا قوم إني بريء مما تشركون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفلت is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position; قال is a past verb; يا is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and بريء its khabar; the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بريء﴾; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), i.e. "free of your associating", or relative, i.e. "of that which you associate with Allah in His worship", the referring pronoun having been omitted; and the clause ﴿قال يا قوم...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿إني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السماوات والأرض حنيفا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause وجهت its khabar (predicate); وجهي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للذي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) وجهت; the clause ﴿فطر السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; السماوات is the mafʿūl bihi, and الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; and حنيفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tāʾ in وجهت.
﴿وما أنا من المشركين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative that acts like ليس, ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-governing negative, ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وحاجه قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; حاجه is a past verb, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and قومه is the fāʿil (agent).
