﴿قال أتحاجوني﴾: قال is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; and تحاجوني [is read] with a doubled nūn, by assimilation of the nūn of the nominative into the nūn of protection (wiqāya).
﴿في الله﴾: في is a preposition, and the name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحاجوني.
﴿وقد هدان﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); ﴿هدان﴾ is a past verb, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ, omitted in writing, is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the yāʾ in أتحاجوني, i.e. "do you dispute with me about Allah while He has guided me?" ﴿ولا أخاف ما تشركون به إلا أن يشاء ربي شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction, so it follows the clause ﴿وقد هدان﴾ in being accusative as a ḥāl; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi, and the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers to ﴿ما﴾, i.e. "I do not fear that which you associate with Allah"; إلا is a particle of exception; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يشاء﴾ is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), because it is of the same kind as the first, the thing excepted from being time, i.e. "except at the time my Lord wills something to be feared"; or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and ﴿إلا﴾ means "but", the interpreted maṣdar being a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "but my Lord's will, I fear it"; and شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وسع ربي كل شيء علما﴾: the clause gives the reason for the exception and has no grammatical position; وسع ربي is a verb and its fāʿil; كل شيء is the mafʿūl bihi; and علمًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, the implied form being "my Lord's knowledge encompasses everything".
﴿أفلا تتذكرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is negative; and تتذكرون is conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "do you turn away from considering that your gods are lifeless objects that neither harm nor benefit, so that you do not remember that they are of this status?"

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وكيف أخاف ما أشركتم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); أخاف is an imperfect verb; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أشركتم is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما أشركتم﴾ is the object of أخاف.
﴿ولا تخافون أنكم أشركتم بالله ما لم ينزل به عليكم سلطانا﴾: ﴿ولا تخافون﴾ is conjoined to أخاف; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "how should I fear that which you associate with Him, and your associating, while you yourselves are not afraid?"; أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause أشركتم بالله its khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi of أشركتم; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينزل; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and سلطانًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأي الفريقين أحق بالأمن إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted condition); أي is an interrogative particle, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أحق its khabar; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تعلمون its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e. "then tell me which of the two parties is more deserving of being followed" [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah reads بالأمن, "of security"].

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿الذين آمنوا﴾: الذين is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mubtadaʾ, on the basis that the speech is from Allah the Exalted; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم يلبسوا إيمانهم بظلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يلبسوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, conjoined to the ṣila; and بظلم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يلبسوا.
﴿أولئك لهم الأمن وهم مهتدون﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الأمن is a second, postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal sentence is the khabar of the demonstrative; the demonstrative clause with what is in its scope is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of an omitted speech on the first view, or nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of الذين on the second view; the wāw is a conjunction, هم is a mubtadaʾ and مهتدون its khabar; and the sentence is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿قل لا أجد في ما أوحي إلي محرما على طاعم يطعمه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿لا أجد﴾ is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); ﴿في ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أجد); the clause ﴿أوحي إليَّ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (إليّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (أوحي); (محرمًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (أجد), i.e. "anything forbidden"; (على طاعم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (محرّم); and the clause ﴿يطعمه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of (طاعم).
﴿إلا أن يكون ميتة أو دما مسفوحا أو لحم خنزير﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (أن يكون) is an accusative excepted [term]; (ميتة) is the khabar (predicate) of (يكون). Its noun is latent, referring to His saying ﴿محرمًا﴾; the clause of exception is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (دمًا) is coordinated (mansūq) with (ميتة); (مسفوحًا) is an adjective (ṣifa), i.e. "flowing", like the blood in the veins, not like the liver and the spleen; and (أو لحم خنزير) is likewise conjoined by coordination (ʿaṭf nasaq).
﴿فإنه رجس أو فسقا أهل لغير الله به﴾: the fāʾ is for causation (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun; (رجس) is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; (فسقًا) is conjoined by coordination (ʿaṭf nasaq) to (لحم خنزير); the clause (أهل) is an adjective (ṣifa); (أهل) is a past verb; (لغير الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهل); and the clause ﴿فإنه رجس﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اضطر) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then there is no blame on him". (غير باغ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and (لا عاد) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (باغ).
﴿فإن ربك غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; (غفور) is a first khabar (predicate) and (رحيم) a second khabar; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿وعلى الذين هادوا حرمنا كل ذي ظفر﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (على الذين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمنا); (هادوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حرمنا) is likewise a verb and its fāʿil; (كل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ذي) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (ظفر) is genitive by the annexation of ﴿ذي﴾ to it.
﴿ومن البقر والغنم حرمنا عليهم شحومهما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (من البقر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمنا); (الغنم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (البقر); (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حرمنا); and (شحومها) [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has (شحومهما)] is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا ما حملت ظهورهما أو الحوايا﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the excepted in a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil) from (الشحوم); the clause of exception is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause ﴿حملت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and (الحوايا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ظهورهما).
﴿أو ما اختلط بعظم﴾: (أو) is a conjunction; (ما) is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ظهورهما); (اختلط) is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (it); and (بعظم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اختلط).
﴿ذلك جزيناهم ببغيهم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. (ذلك): the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿جزيناهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the linking pronoun is omitted, the implied form being "We recompensed them with it" (جزيناهم به). (ببغيهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جزيناهم﴾.
﴿وإنا لصادقون﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (صادقون) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the position of the accusative.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿فإن كذبوك فقل ربكم ذو رحمة واسعة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (كذبوك) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) is an imperative verb; (ربكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (ذو رحمة) is the khabar (predicate); (واسعة) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (رحمة); the clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); and the clause of saying with what lies within its scope is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ولا يرد بأسه عن القوم المجرمين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the nominal clause, falling within the scope of the saying; (يرد) is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); (بأسه) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (عن القوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يرد); and (المجرمين) is an adjective (naʿt) of (القوم).

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿سيقول الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما أشركنا ولا آباؤنا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of the future; (يقول) is an imperfect verb; (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (أشركوا) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause ﴿لو شاء الله﴾ is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (لو) is conditional; (شاء الله) is a verb and its fāʿil, and the object of the willing is omitted, i.e. "had He willed our not associating"; and (لا آباؤنا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun in (أشركنا), the conjoining being permissible because of the presence of ﴿لا﴾.
﴿ولا حرمنا من شيء﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ما أشركنا﴾; and (من) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), on the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with a denial like that denial, those before them denied"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿كذب﴾ is a past verb; ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلهم﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿حتى ذاقوا بأسنا﴾: (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (ذاقوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and (بأسنا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قل هل عندكم من علم فتخرجوه لنا﴾: (قل) is an imperative verb; (هل) is an interrogative particle; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (من) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), on the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and the clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying). The fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تخرجوه) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an "an" implied (muḍmara) after it; "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "do you have any knowledge, and so a bringing of it out to us?"; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (لنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرجوه).
﴿إن تتبعون إلا الظن﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is negating; (تتبعون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (الظن) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإن أنتم إلا تخرصون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إن) is negating; (أنتم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause ﴿تخرصون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (أنتم).

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿قل فلله الحجة البالغة﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition, i.e. "say: if you have no proof, then to Allah belongs the conclusive proof"; (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (الحجة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (البالغة) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
﴿فلو شاء لهداكم أجمعين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لو) is conditional; (شاء) is a verb with a latent fāʿil (agent), and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "your guidance"; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو); (هداكم) is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and (أجمعين) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿قل هلم شهداءكم الذين يشهدون أن الله حرم هذا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قل) is an imperative verb; (هلم) is a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr); (شهداءكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause (يشهدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أن الله﴾: (أن) is an abrogating particle and the Divine Name is its noun; "anna" and its noun are in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); and the clause (حرم هذا) is the khabar (predicate) of (أن).
﴿فإن شهدوا فلا تشهد معهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (إن) is conditional; (شهدوا) is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is prohibitive; (تشهد) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and (معهم) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تشهد).
﴿ولا تتبع أهواء الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبع) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (أهواء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); (بآياتنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذبوا); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة وهم بربهم يعدلون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (الذين) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (بالآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون); the wāw is a conjunction; (هم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يعدلون) is its khabar (predicate); and (بربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعدلون).

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم ربكم عليكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause (تعالوا) is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (تعالوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أتل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), or the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (حرم عليكم) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "that which He forbade". Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. "I will recite your Lord's forbidding", and ﴿ما حرم﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) occupying the place of the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ربكم﴾ is the fāʿil of (حرم), and (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرم﴾ or to ﴿أتل﴾.
﴿ألا تشركوا به شيئا وبالوالدين إحسانا﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya); (لا) is prohibitive; (تشركوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and it with what lies within its scope is a badal (substitute) of ﴿ما حرم﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تشركوا﴾. The clause ﴿لا تشركوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it has the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun); (بالوالدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted verb of the maṣdar, i.e. "do good to the parents" (أحسنوا بالوالدين); and (إحسانًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of the omitted verb.
﴿ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق نحن نرزقكم وإياهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (أولادكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من إملاق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقتلوا), i.e. "because of poverty", so (من) is causal; (نحن) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (نرزقكم) is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿نحن نرزقكم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, and it is to give the cause of the prohibition before it; and (إياهم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun in (نرزقكم).
﴿ولا تقربوا الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقربوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفواحش) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of (الفواحش), and it is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); the clause ﴿ظهر﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ظهر); and (ما بطن) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ما ظهر).
﴿ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (النفس) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (التي) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿حرم الله﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (بالحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in ﴿تقتلوا﴾, i.e. "do not kill it except clothed in right", or attached to something omitted standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective (naʿt) of the maṣdar, i.e. "except with a killing clothed in right".
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تعقلون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تعقلون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن حتى يبلغ أشده﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقربوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (مال اليتيم) is its object; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بالتي): the relative noun is an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقربوا), i.e. "except in the manner which is best"; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (أحسن) its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يبلغ) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after (حتى); "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar made genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تقربوا); and (أشده) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأوفوا الكيل والميزان بالقسط﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf); (أوفوا الكيل) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الميزان) is conjoined to (الكيل), accusative; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (أوفوا), i.e. "being equitable and just", or a ḥāl of the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "complete".
﴿لا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها﴾: (لا) is negating. (نكلف): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (نفسًا): a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (وسعها): a second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿لا نكلف...﴾ is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا قلتم فاعدلوا ولو كان ذا قربى وبعهد الله أوفوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إذا) is conditional and adverbial; the clause (قلتم) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the fāʾ is a linking one; (اعدلوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) is a non-jussive conditional; (كان) is a defective past verb, its noun a latent pronoun and (ذا قربى) its khabar (predicate); (بعهد الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوفوا); and (أوفوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تذكرون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تذكرون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿وأن هذا صراطي مستقيما فاتبعوه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; (أن) is an abrogating particle; (هذا) is its noun; (صراطي) is its khabar (predicate); (مستقيمًا) is a corroborative ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida) of (صراطي), its governing element being the sense of pointing; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); (اتبعوه) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتبعوا السبل فتفرق بكم عن سبيله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبعوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (السبل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فتفرق﴾: the fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (al-sababiyya), and (تفرق) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an "an" implied (muḍmara) after the fāʾ in the answer to the prohibition; "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no following of the paths from you, and then a scattering". (بكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تفرق); and (عن سبيله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "far removed from His path".
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (ذلكم) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تتقون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تتقون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب﴾: (ثم) is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (آتينا موسى الكتاب) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects.
﴿تماما﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of completing the favour and honour"; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الكتاب), i.e. "in the state of its being complete"; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We gave it to him with a complete giving, without deficiency"; or a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent), i.e. "completing".
﴿على الذي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمامًا﴾, i.e. "upon the one who excelled in carrying it out"; and the clause ﴿أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position.
﴿وتفصيلا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تمامًا﴾.
﴿لكل شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تفصيلًا﴾.
﴿وهدى ورحمة لعلهم بلقاء ربهم يؤمنون﴾: (هدى) and (رحمة) are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تمامًا﴾ and ﴿تفصيلًا﴾; (لعل) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (بلقاء ربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and the clause (يؤمنون) is the khabar (predicate) of (لعل).
